The Miami-Dade County mayor is apparently allowed to negotiate deals under $1 million without the approval of the local commission--this is why the $975,000 Kaseya Center project went ahead without pushback.
Levine Cava is looking to make more deals with Rockstar to promote GTA 6 at the city's airports and ship ports, along with various other places, but it remains to be seen if those will be approved.
GTA 6 launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S--for more, check out the newly released launch trailer, which features some steamy scenes.

title: Killing PS5 Discs Just Makes Sense, Even If It Angers People, Former PlayStation Exec Says
text:
Ken Kutaragi, the former PlayStation executive known colloquially as the "Father of PlayStation," has reacted to the ongoing debate and discussion about physical games in the wake of Sony's announcement that it will end support for PS5 game discs in 2028.
Speaking to VGC , Kutaragi said he understands that people think they "own" games when they buy them physically. However, he said, "Nobody thinks [physical media] is necessary for a networked device like a smartphone, for example, because people feel that they will keep their content."
He went on to say that he "really" does understand why some people are upset about PlayStation's decision to end discs. After all, Sony continues to sell millions and millions of physical games annually , and in some regions, sales of new games on PS5 are more than 50% physical .
However, as many others have said and data shows, consumers are increasingly leaning toward digital, and that trend is only expected to continue.
"I don’t think it’s economically reasonable [to continue to support discs]. Maybe it’s a mentality issue," he said.
For its part, Sony said ending support for physical discs is a "natural direction" for the company as it adapts to consumer trends. One expert believes Sony killing discs is really about profitability and control .
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4FatSqS3VYY
Kutaragi went on to say he understands that PlayStation's teams now include people who came from "outside," including people from streaming companies through Sony's buyout of streaming service Gaikai . As such, he thinks it only makes sense that these new hires might see PlayStation as "not just a game console, but also a content terminal."
"Maybe that’s how those people are thinking. But this has caused some friction with game enthusiasts," he said.
While Sony might be giving up on physical games, Nintendo doesn't plan to do that, at least not yet . Microsoft has not specified its plans for discs going forward, but most expect Xbox to kill off discs as well .

title: Big Walk Won’t Come To Xbox Until Microsoft Is No Longer A BDS Boycott Target
text:
Big Walk has been a critical hit since it launched a few months ago on PC and PS5, but one major platform where you won't find it is Xbox Series X|S. That's no accident: Developer House House said its decision not to release the game on Xbox was a show of support for the Palestinian-led Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions (BDS) movement.
"It has always been our intention for Big Walk to be played by groups of friends, and we know that keeping the game off Xbox runs counter to those intentions," House House wrote in a statement. "This decision means that some people will miss out on playing Big Walk with their friends, and we understand the disappointment we’re causing. We are disappointed too. We would love for people to be able to play the game on Xbox, but not until Microsoft and/or Xbox have been removed as BDS boycott targets. We’ve made this decision with the belief that meaningful change can be made in the world, that coordinated collective action can confront even the most powerful interests, and that one day, Palestine will be free."
Microsoft became a priority target of the BDS initiative due to the contracts it had with the Israeli government and military. BDS has called for a boycott of the company, and by extension, all Xbox games, hardware, and subscriptions.
In response to the announcement by House House, The Palestinian BDS movement wrote in a statement (via People Makes Games' Chris Bratt ) that it "wholeheartedly" supports the developers decision and that it encourages "gamers, game developers, games journalists, and workers" to sign the No Games for Genocide pledge and continue to boycott Xbox.
That pressure on Microsoft has had results, as last year, the company did block the Israeli government from accessing its cloud storage and AI systems, which has reportedly been used to surveil Palestinians in both the West Bank and Gaza.
While some people have asked why Big Walk is available on PCs running a Windows operating system, it is worth noting that purchasing it through a marketplace like Steam does not mean that Microsoft gets a cut of sales from the game, compared to how it would if the game was sold through its Xbox marketplace.

title: This Anime Stalker Russian Roulette Game Is Afraid AI Copycats Will Steal Its Ideas
text:
Developers have dealt with copycat games for many years, but generative AI has made it easier than ever to whip up a clone, and that problem has grown in recent years. The developer behind Drunken Goddess Reflux is aware of this, and out of fear that its anime Russian roulette game could be the victim of a cash-grab imitation, it has announced that it has canceled its upcoming public demo. Instead, Alliance Arts will hold closed online play sessions for a limited number of players.
https://youtu.be/SRFDW2Pm9nk
"We sincerely apologize for the short notice to everyone who was looking forward to it," the developer wrote online . "We're concerned that the demo's content could be used to quickly imitate or replicate the game's presentation and gameplay with AI or other tools, and that such works could be released before our launch."
Alliance Arts is also concerned that it can't properly manage restrictions on posting and streaming content from the game, and it'll instead hand out demo keys and collect feedback for the game through its group Discord. The studio's fears aren't unwarranted, with the upcoming Needle in a Haystack being a prime example of Steam's copycat problem. After the game was announced in August and a clip of its purposefully tedious gameplay went viral--you genuinely are just looking for a needle in a haystack--clones quickly popped up online.
A quick search on Steam reveals several games all with a similar theme, and these have been released within weeks of each other.
Looks a little sus to me.
What happened here? AI-assisted games have been popping up more and more lately on Steam, and while you'll seldom find disclosure text indicating that agents like Claude and ChatGPT have been used in their development, the fast turnaround, near-identical gameplay, and artwork with a telltale yellow filter suggest that the tech played a heavy hand in quickly whipping up a clone.
With Claude 5.5 making it easier than ever to decompile a game into code that's playable within a browser, Alliance Arts might be justified in wanting to keep the game within a tight-knit circle of players. It's not unfeasible to imagine a bad actor using the code for the demo to generate a carbon copy and put that up for sale on Steam.
Hit multiplayer game Meccha Chameleon also has its fair share of copycats, as shortly after release, a wave of new games copied its hide-and-seek-with-bad-art formula.
The Drunken Goddess Reflux demo cancellation comes shortly before the start of Steam Next Fest this month, but with the event having become a dumping ground for demos, it could have been buried under thousands of other games vying for player attention. It's currently one of the top 100 most-wishlisted games on Steam, so there's plenty of interest.
In case you missed it when it was first revealed several months ago, Drunken Goddess Reflux combines alcohol with a demonic Tsundere anime lady and the deadly game of Russian roulette. It's a game of shots and shots, as the drunker you get, the better your odds are of not receiving a lead headache. The game officially launches on December 8 for PC.

title: Next Red Dead Launching By 2027 Or 2028 “May Not Be Unreasonable,” Bank Says, But It Definitely Is
text:
Citi, the investment bank and financial services company, has released a note about GTA 6 and Rockstar, and included in the brief is a line about what Rockstar could release next--a new Red Dead game.
The company said in its memo that, if Rockstar is telling the truth that GTA 6 did not in fact cost $1.5 billion to make , then the studio may be able to get a new Red Dead game out sooner than anyone might have imagined.
Citi said a new Red Dead game releasing in 2027 or 2028 "may not be unreasonable," according to Yahoo Finance .
A scene from Red Dead Redemption II.
The bank might be saying this, but it would be incredibly shocking, for a number of reasons, if a new Red Dead game releases as soon as next year.
There are historically years between major Rockstar releases, and even longer gaps between entries in the same series. For example, Red Dead Redemption launched in 2010, followed by GTA 5 in 2013, then Red Dead Redemption II in 2018, and now GTA 6 in 2026.
Another notable element to consider is how Rockstar makes games today. The company tried to develop GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption II concurrently, and if it was able to pull it off, Rockstar claimed it would have been able to release GTA 6 years earlier . However, Rockstar deemed this too ambitious, with studio head Rob Nelson opting to reassign staff from GTA 6 to Red Dead Redemption II to help get it out the door.
At one point in time, developed multiple games concurrently across offices, but now, Rockstar’s network of teams work on one project together before moving on to the next.
GTA 6 may be coming out soon, but Rockstar no doubt has committed extensive resources to post-launch support, and that's not even mentioning the next evolution of GTA Online . Although Rockstar has announced no plans for online support whatsoever for GTA 6, it's expected that GTA 6 will have some kind of extensive online experience that is supported for years to come.
At the same time, a company like Rockstar is no doubt planning for the future already, and a new Red Dead game would seem like an extremely safe bet. After all, Red Dead Redemption II has sold a breathtaking 87 million copies, making it one of the best-selling games of all time .
Faster development
While Rockstar getting a new Red Dead out in 2027 or 2028 might be extremely ambitious and wishful thinking on the part of Citi, Rockstar and parent company Take-Two have indicated that new structures are in place to help make games faster.
CEO Strauss Zelnick told The Game Business that people should not "confuse long development cycles with a lackadaisical approach to development cycles."
Some games are "so complex and so challenging to build" that they simply take a long time to make. However, Zelnick said "recent development in technology" may be able to help Take-Two's studio's "compress some development timelines without compromising quality."
Zelnick may be referring to Take-Two's embrace of AI here , but it's unclear. Rockstar's Phil Hooker, meanwhile, said the company's hiring spree and updates to its technology stack should help Rockstar make games faster in the future .
Something else to consider here is that Zelnick and Hooker might be talking more to analysts and investors with their comments about making games faster. Only time will tell if it's actually another eight years before Rockstar releases another game after GTA 6; for now, it's just talk.

title: The Blood Of Dawnwalker’s Next Update Will Let You Erase Your Mistakes And Pet The Dog
text:
The Blood of Dawnwalker is already one of the best role-playing games of the year, but developer Rebel Wolves is preparing a big update that should make it even better. Like all good things in life, it starts with getting to pet a dog.
Update 1.1, which is scheduled to arrive next week, brings a number of new features to the game, including the ability to pet both dogs and cats via the game's directional system, which is currently only used for combat. It will also feature a new Story difficulty setting that provides "additional combat assist," new subtitle settings across all lines of dialogue, and most crucially, an item called Draught of Mind Rebirth.
The Draught of Mind Rebirth will allow you to forget all the skills and abilities you've acquired across the Swordmastery, Witchcraft, and Vampirism trees. Not only will this give you the chance to reallocate your points in a way that best fits your playstyle--it will also give you back the time associated with those skills. That means you'll have the chance to complete extra missions if you happen to find yourself impeded with Dawnwalker's 30-day limit. However, we don't find the system to be restrictive as it currently stands.
The Blood of Dawnwalker Update 1.1
Alongside the new features, Update 1.1. will also feature some tweaks to existing systems. These include an update to the FrameGen system, improvements to the camera, better Shadowstep and Planeshift abilities, and the removal of censorship of blood in the Japanese version. It will also include combat improvements that should make it easier to correctly target your enemy of choice--currently, it's a little finicky because of the direction-based system which prioritizes you blocking incoming attacks--regardless of who's trying to strike you--over you focusing in on a particular enemy.
The Blood of Dawnwalker is out now on PS5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC. In our review , Phil Hornshaw said, "The Blood of Dawnwalker is the kind of RPG that feels great to get lost in, that digs into your mind and stays there, and which is worth scouring and savoring."

title: Call Of Duty: MW4’s Campaign Launches Today, Please Don’t Spoil It For Others
text:
It's a big day for Call of Duty, as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's campaign is playable beginning today, October 16, for people who preorder the game.
The campaign is available to preload now, but doesn't unlock until 10 AM PT / 1 PM ET. You can play early across PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Switch 2, and PC.
Developer Infinity Ward issued a statement, asking people to please not spoil the story. "We've one one ask. Let everyone experience it for themselves. Keep the campaign spoilers under wraps," Infinity Ward said. "Time to go dark."
A scene from MW4's campaign.
MW4 is expected to wrap up the current Modern Warfare storyline that began with 2019's Modern Warfare. Activision boss Tyler Bahl told The Game Business that MW4 is the "epic conclusion of the recent series of Modern Warfare."
"It’s not that some characters and pieces can’t live on beyond this and be reinvented. But we’re excited by closing this chapter and launching a new one," he said. "Where we go with future games, we have to innovate."
To that end, Bahl also confirmed that a new sub-franchise for Call of Duty is in the works after years of Modern Warfare and Black Ops games.
MW4 officially launches on October 23, but the early access doesn't end with campaign, as the new version of DMZ unlocks on October 20 for people who preordered the game . Multiplayer won't be available until October 23.

title: A Comically On-The-Nose New Title Has Me Even More Excited For This Upcoming Tactics Game
text:
I was already looking forward to upcoming tactics game Australia Did It , but now I've got another reason to do so: a hilariously expanded new name.
In a fun turn of events, designer Rami Ismail has revealed a new subtitle has officially been adopted. Back in August, he posted a suggestion about the name that had been made as part of a localization report that turned out to be incredible.
"One localisation report for Australia Did It returned with a note that the game's title won't work in their territory & suggested to instead use 'Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defence Business' and now I want that, like, globally," he wrote at the time.
He subsequently asked fans to express their support for the name, in the hopes he could use it to convince publisher Mystic Forge to actually adopt the subtitle. And with this week's announcement of a release date, the news was confirmed, and the game will officially be called Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pBFlZ8MmbFA
The original, subtitle-less name was certainly memorable. Despite a sea of games coming out at all times that seek to push everything more than five seconds old out of my brain, it was the rare game whose name actually stuck in my head since it first caught my eye last year. That said, there is something about the combination of proper hyphenation and the almost-sarcastic precision of this new subtitle that I just love.
Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business (sorry, I just wanted to write it again) releases on Steam on November 10. A demo is still available, and I highly recommend it--the game has a fun blend of genres going on. To simply call it a roguelite tactics game sells it short from what I've played. Half of the game sees you defending a base in the style of tower defense, while the other has you managing units who defend your train once it finally gets on the move. What I enjoyed most, though, is a fun system that lets you combine distinct units in order to create new ones that blend their abilities together. (There's a great dash of manipulating enemy and unit positioning, too, which I'm always a sucker for.)
We'll see next month if the quality of the demo can sustain itself in the long haul, but whatever the case, at least it'll do so with a kickass name.

title: 《GTA6》发售预告的33个新细节
text:
相关文章: 《GTA6》有资格角逐TGA年度游戏
《GTA6》又放出了新影像，是时候仔细研究一番了。我们逐帧细看了这支新预告，找出了其中隐藏的各种有趣细节。从部分火爆任务的片段，到杰森军旅生涯的更多线索，再到不止一次出现的热气腾腾的淋浴场景，这次有不少新内容值得一看。
不再耽搁了。以下就是我们在《GTA6》发售预告中发现的33处细节。多个镜头让我们得以近距离观察杰森，也让我们对这位将由玩家操控的角色有了相当清晰的认识。我们已经知道他曾经当过兵，而在预告片中段，他穿着的一件美国陆军T恤透露了更多服役经历。 还有更多相关内容 Rockstar透露《GTA6》原本可能更早发售
1．首先，杰森似乎曾在一所位于North Fort Law的战斗训练学校受训。系列老玩家会认出，这正是初代《GTA》中的军事基地。在初代游戏中，这座基地位于新根西州（New Guernsey），但杰森就读的那所学校更有可能位于奥尔德尼州，也就是高清宇宙中对应新泽西州的地方。我们知道露西娅来自自由城，而自由城位于邻近的自由州——或许两人就是在杰森驻扎于基地期间认识的？
2．比那些小字更醒目的是「Marauder（掠夺者）」一词，与此前视频中杰森手臂上的骷髅降落伞纹身相呼应。「掠夺者」想必就是他服役时所在的部队，也可能是在致敬现实中活跃于20世纪40年代的特种部队「麦瑞尔突击队」。如今与这支部队对应的是第75游骑兵团，因此杰森很可能曾是一名游骑兵。
3．杰森退伍后的日子似乎不太好过。他在预告片开头说道：「我在军队里惹了些麻烦，离开的时候闹得不太愉快。」「他们不给我这样的人贷款，什么都不给。」处境如此，也难怪杰森走上了犯罪道路。毕竟生活成本还在不断上涨！
4．好在杰森在「掠夺者」的经历，似乎让他具备了在犯罪生涯中大展身手所需的全套本领。画面中，他身穿类似特种部队的潜入装备，头戴夜视仪，手持装有消音器的突击步枪，涉水前进。同行的还有另外两名男子，三人似乎刚从一艘船上下来。泛着淡红色的夜空确实很有佛罗里达州的味道（或者该说是雷奥奈达州），但画面左侧一只模样奇特的爬行动物看起来却像科莫多巨蜥，而这种动物原产于印度尼西亚。这是在回忆杰森从军期间执行的一次任务吗？还是说，这只爬行动物只是雷奥奈达湿地的本地物种，而杰森可能找来了几位昔日战友，帮忙干一票？
5．预告片中展示的许多犯罪行动，都带着几分军事行动的味道。后面的画面里，杰森身穿防弹背心坐在直升机上，举止十分专业。他身边还有一只狗，这或许不仅暗示杰森养了宠物，还暗示玩家能让狗协助执行某些任务。再往后的镜头中，杰森从容地走下直升机，检查步枪膛内的子弹。这些都是小细节，却共同勾勒出了一位能力出众的专业人士。
6．露西娅或许没有杰森那样训练有素的背景，但她似乎最终至少会学会他的一部分战术。预告片播放到一分钟时，可以看到她身穿特种部队风格的黑色服装，手持Shrewsbury转轮式榴弹发射器，向追击的警车发射榴弹。
7．她挂在某种货网上，从高处炸毁这些车辆。几秒后，画面中出现了一架直升机，用非常相似的货网吊着一大批货物。这些镜头很可能来自同一个任务，而露西娅挂在货网上的这一幕，应该发生在货网被拖着撞穿摩天大楼外墙之前或之后。
8．这次撞击造成的破坏，比我们在以往任何一部《GTA》游戏中见过的都更精细，数以百计的玻璃碎片从大楼侧面飞溅而出。虽然仅凭这个镜头，还远不足以确认游戏会采用类似《战地风云》的破坏技术，但这段炫目的画面让我们看到了Rockstar能把环境破坏做得多么细致。
9．以《GTA》系列通常描绘的犯罪规模，出现这样的附带破坏并不意外，而本作似乎也无意在场面规模上逊于《GTA5》中最宏大的那些桥段。画面中，露西娅从一辆车上跃向一架民航客机，暗示这段情节的规模可与崔佛的某些空中特技场面相媲美。这个镜头很可能衔接的是第二支预告片中的一幕：飞机正在放下起落架，露西娅则在货舱内搏斗。
10．前面提到的直升机任务很可能是一次抢劫，但预告中那场银行劫案肯定是。这其实就是我们此前在8月独家首发的截图中见过的金库，燃烧的钞票和扎着马尾的露西娅也都在画面中。
11．在这个镜头中，与露西娅同行的不是杰森，而是另一名身份不明的角色。我们看不到这名角色的脸，但无论对方是谁，看起来我们实施抢劫时都不会孤身一人。在后面的一个镜头中，露西娅身旁还有几名伪装成建筑工人的枪手，这暗示我们身边可能经常会有犯罪团伙成员同行。但他们会是随剧情登场的配角，还是像《GTA5》的抢劫团队那样，由玩家雇来帮忙的NPC？
12．抢现金是久经验证的捞钱手段，不过《GTA6》也有可能尝试更去中心化的路子。我们看到一架双翼飞机飞过罪恶都市的海滩，机身侧面醒目地印着「DacityCoin」的标志。这大概是在恶搞比特币，但它为什么会在预告片里如此抢眼？为什么还有个人攀在机翼上，放出亮粉色的烟雾信号？我们的猜测是，杰森和露西娅会参与某种骗局，而这场特技表演是在为一种虚假的加密货币打广告。
13．预告中展现的高速刺激体验不只有飞机。稍后我们还看到了街头竞速，我们在8月的加长展示中首次见到了这项支线活动。
14．当然，《GTA》系列中的高速驾驶，大多是在和警察竞速。一段简短的追车画面中，一名主角驾驶着一辆青柠绿色超跑，逃避从四面八方赶来的警察。似乎每支新预告都会展示新车，这次我们也短暂瞥见了全新的Invetero Coquette，它只出现了一瞬间——留意那套绿松石色与粉色相间的合成器浪潮风格涂装。
15．如果你更喜欢海浪而不是柏油路，那么Shasa或许更能让你尽兴，它看起来是《GTA6》中的一款新船。我们能看到杰森和他的朋友卡尔正在给一艘Shasa干活，打磨抛光船身漆面。这似乎就是故事开场时杰森的生活：他已经结束军旅生涯，正在Brian的码头当工人。
16．Brian的生意看起来相当忙碌——租赁区的架子上摆满了船只和水上摩托——但雷奥奈达州可不只有本地商户，还有规模大得多的企业。在靠前的一个镜头背景中，我们能看到一辆Globe Oil的卡车。这家公司曾在另外几款游戏中出现，你可能在《GTA4》，甚至《GTA：血战唐人街》中见过它。在后者中，我们还用过这家公司的汽油制作燃烧瓶。
17．说到火热，露西娅和杰森之间显然也燃着爱火。镜头中，两人站在一间公寓的阳台上，能望见海滩。这处安全屋不同于加长版预告中那间更简陋的住所，暗示我们不仅会四处奔走，生活境况也会有所提升。
18．「我们会没事的吧？」露西娅问道。「我们经历了那么多，一直都在一起。这次也得撑过去。」杰森回答道，再次突出了这对情侣亡命天涯的故事基调。不过，他们并非孤立无援，还有不少角色会帮助他们。
19．但愿卡尔不是他们这边最聪明的人。到目前为止，他每次在预告片中露面，都显得有点傻乎乎的。这次我们看到他逗弄一条宠物蛇，还凑上嘴唇，轻轻亲了一下它分叉的舌头。
20．说到爬行动物，画面中还能看到一只鬣蜥横穿马路，进一步展现了雷奥奈达州野生动物的多样性。《GTA6》将设有动物观察系统，让我们寻找各种动物，并将它们一一记录在册。
21．由Roxy和Bae-Luxe组成的说唱二人组Real Dimez再次短暂亮相。我们对她们的了解还不多。她们会是朋友，还是敌人？我们知道，她们签约了夜店大亨Boobie Ike旗下的Only Raw Records，但Boobie Ike本人对我们来说也仍然充满谜团。
22．有一个人我们肯定不想招惹，那就是罪城警察局的警员Mendez。他只在一个镜头中短暂露面，但给人的感觉确实像是《GTA6》的主要反派之一，颇有塞缪尔·杰克逊在《GTA：圣安地列斯》中饰演的汤普尼警官的架势。
23．接下来还能看到更多警察，多辆警车驶离公路，越野追捕嫌疑人。这些警车属于Mariana县，列奥尼达群岛就位于地图上的这片区域。
24．看来，即使不追捕杰森和露西娅，警方在全州各地也有不少事情要忙。一个近景镜头展示了几名坐在绿色汽车里、看起来满身文身的帮派成员。其中一人身上纹着「EW」；这会不会是帮派名称的线索？现在就来猜猜吧。
25．还有那些戴着巴拉克拉法帽、围着一堆金色AK步枪跳舞的人，难道也属于某个古怪的帮派？他们要么是看了太多遍哈莫尼·科林的《春假》，要么只是在拿着枪摆造型。画面是透过数码镜头拍摄他们的，所以这也许是在为Only Raw旗下某位艺人拍摄写真或音乐录影带？
26．再看主角这边，我们能看到抢银行的行家Raul Bautista在建筑工地威胁一名男子。他似乎也是杰森和露西娅的同伙。从背景中的这块招牌判断，这片区域看起来属于Schlott Construction。这家公司曾随「进出口大亨」更新出现在《GTA Online》的载具涂装上，不过这一次，它看起来会在列奥尼达拥有更多实体设施。
27．Raul似乎很享受欺负人的过程，一边大口啃鸡肉，一边踩踏一名男子。这桶鸡肉会不会来自Cluckin’ Bell？如果是，那它的包装设计相比《GTA：圣安地列斯》时期可变了不少，从这里的画面来看，新包装借鉴了其现实原型肯德基。不过，我不太确定这鸡肉的品质如何，那根鸡腿看起来没多少肉。
28．杰森显然更偏爱大腿。画面中，他和爱人露西娅一起淋浴，帮彼此清洗身体。没什么别的可看，只是两个人非常关心对方的个人卫生罢了。他对清洁如此认真，甚至还用手擦拭淋浴间，而露西娅则给了他一个吻，感谢他的帮忙。预告片稍后的画面再次展示了两人互相照顾的情景。露西娅踮起脚尖，大概是为了够到杰森的头，帮他洗头。真是太贴心了。希望她的电子脚镣能防水，不然这一切可能会以灾难收场。
29．洗澡看来是个好主意，因为《GTA6》看起来会是一款让人汗流浃背的游戏。我们已经听说过Rockstar那套细致到离谱的汗水技术，如今，一位在健身房向我们展示肌肉的男子，让我们看到了这套技术的实际效果。希望我们不用跟他打架。
30．不过，如果真要打，带上指虎或许是个明智之举。画面中可以看到杰森戴上了指虎。这种近战武器在多部《GTA》游戏中都出现过，不过，当我们在《GTA：罪恶都市》中造访20世纪80年代的罪恶都市时，它的名字还是Brass Knuckles。
31．要干掉几英尺以外的敌人，杰森就需要换种武器了。画面中，他手持一把狙击步枪，瞄准镜的反光里能看到一架直升机，就等着被击落。预告片更早的一处镜头，可能就展示了杰森扣动扳机后的情景：他迈步离开，身后的直升机坠毁，化作一团火球。众所周知，真男人从不回头看爆炸。我们还能发现，他戴着一只耳机，谁在跟他说话？想必不是飞行员。至少现在已经不是了。
32．既然我们正在尝试拼凑剧情线索，不妨留意一下：露西娅在这支预告片结尾穿的金色连衣裙，正是第二支预告片中着重展示过的那一件。这些情节看起来可能都属于同一个大型任务：任务从一艘游艇开始，随后转到Nine1Nine夜店，杰森和露西娅还得在某个时刻从屋顶跳进夜店的泳池。他们为什么要逃跑？很快，到了11月19日，我们就都能知道答案了。
33．贯穿整支预告片的配乐，是法国电子音乐双人组合Justice专为这款游戏录制的一首新单曲，他们也负责创作游戏的原创配乐。这首《Flower in a Hurricane》还汇集了带来澳大利亚迷幻风格的Tame Impala、同样来自澳大利亚的摇滚乐队King Gizzard & The Lizard Wizard，以及美国创作歌手SZA。到目前为止，《GTA6》公开的所有画面中都还没有出现真正的飓风，但我们已经知道，极端天气会在游戏中发挥作用。

title: 《Big Walk》开发商解释为何缺席XBOX
text:
相关文章: 《Big Walk》评测
《Big Walk》开发商House House解释了抵制XBOX的原因，这也是该作未登陆微软主机的原因。
开发过《鹅作剧》的澳大利亚工作室House House，今年早些时候在PC、PS5和Switch 2上推出了设计巧妙的合作解谜冒险游戏《Big Walk》，唯独没有登陆XBOX Series。《Big Walk》发售后广受好评，Metacritic评分达到91分，还多次入选年度游戏候选名单。
还有更多相关内容 《Big Walk》发售宣传视频
IGN为《Big Walk》打出了9分。我们在评测中写道：「《Big Walk》是一款让人收获满满的合作冒险游戏。你与好友一同探索广阔的开放世界、解开设计巧妙的谜题时，会遇到许多自然涌现的美好瞬间。」自那以后，粉丝们一直想知道，这款游戏为何没有登陆XBOX。House House在官网发布声明，表示这一决定是为了支持「抵制、撤资、制裁」（Boycott, Divestment, Sanctions，简称BDS）运动组织。该组织自称是「由巴勒斯坦人领导、争取自由、正义与平等的运动」。
BDS将XBOX列为「优先」抵制目标，并已发起行动，呼吁玩家、主播和开发者抵制微软的游戏业务。据BBC报道，微软与以色列政府的合作一直存在争议，公司内部也不例外，一些员工因此发起了抗议。
House House表示，「在微软和／或XBOX不再被BDS列为抵制目标之前」，工作室不会在XBOX上推出《Big Walk》。
以下为House House声明全文：
关于XBOX平台
2026年6月，我们宣布《Big Walk》将仅在PC、Nintendo Switch 2和PS5平台推出。此后，我们收到了许多消息和评论，询问游戏未来是否会登陆XBOX。我们希望在这里统一回应这些问题。我们已经决定不在XBOX平台推出《Big Walk》。这一决定是为了响应由巴勒斯坦方面发起的BDS（抵制、撤资与制裁）运动对微软的抵制呼吁。该运动已将微软游戏业务（包括XBOX）列为重点抵制对象。如果你希望进一步了解我们作出这一决定的原因，我们建议阅读有关微软为何被BDS列为重点抵制目标的资料，了解此类施压行动迄今已经在微软身上取得的成果。我们尤其推荐观看People Make Games制作的这部出色的入门介绍视频。我们一直希望《Big Walk》能够成为一款让朋友们一起游玩的游戏，也清楚不推出XBOX版本的决定与这一初衷相违背。这一决定意味着，有些玩家将无法与朋友一起体验《Big Walk》，我们理解这会让他们感到失望。我们自己也同样感到遗憾。我们非常希望玩家能够在XBOX上体验这款游戏，但在微软和／或XBOX不再被BDS列为抵制对象之前，我们不会这样做。我们作出这一决定，是因为我们相信，这个世界能够发生真正有意义的改变；我们相信，有组织的集体行动能够与最强大的利益集团抗衡；我们也相信，终有一天，巴勒斯坦将获得自由。
感谢大家的理解。
此致，
House House

title: 《GTA6》有资格角逐TGA年度游戏
text:
相关文章: 《GTA6》发售预告的33个新细节
随着The Game Awards（TGA）确认今年的参评截止日期，《GTA6》正式获得了角逐2026年年度游戏奖的资格。
根据TGA官网的常见问题解答，游戏必须在2026年11月20日星期五当天或之前发售，才有资格参评。《GTA6》目前定于2026年11月19日发售，仅比截止日期早一天，刚好赶上。 还有更多相关内容 Rockstar透露《GTA6》原本可能更早发售
当然，今年的提名名单尚未公布，但很难想象《GTA6》不会在符合参评条件的多数奖项中获得提名，甚至可能全部入围。Sandfall Interactive的《光与影：33号远征队》在去年颁奖礼上一举拿下九项大奖，保持着TGA获奖数量最多的世界纪录。《GTA6》能打破这一纪录吗？
此外，据报道，《GTA Online2》——不管这个多人模式最终叫什么名字——预计将于明年推出，或许还会与PC版一同登场。因此，我们可能会看到《GTA6》在2027年TGA上再次参与角逐。

title: 《NAUTUS》公开测试宣传视频
text:
神秘的事物正潜伏在深海之中
当你抵达偏远的N.A.U.T.U.S.研究站时，却惊讶地发现，站内的科学家竟然莫名其妙地对海洋产生了强烈恐惧。现在，你需要与好友一起驾驶可不断升级的潜艇，在海浪之下迎战变异生物，同时在陆地上建设属于自己的热带岛屿基地。但千万别被这座美丽的小岛迷惑——神秘的事物正潜伏在深海之中，唯有你才能揭开背后的真相！《NAUTUS》现已开启公开测试。

title: 世嘉下架《全面战争：幕府将军2》重制版
text:
相关文章: 《全面战争：幕府将军2 完全版》发售宣传视频
《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版的重制质量遭到大量投诉后，Creative Assembly与世嘉已将这款游戏从Steam下架。 还有更多相关内容 《全面战争：幕府将军2 完全版》游戏概览预告
这款重制版于10月13日推出，为备受喜爱的这款2011年经典策略游戏翻新画面，对Creative Assembly来说本应是十拿九稳的事。世嘉此前大力宣传游戏「升级后的视觉效果」，包括「改进的纹理、模型、光照、阴影、雾效与环境，以及现代渲染、抗锯齿和分辨率放大选项」。游戏还提供可选的2.5D战役动画，灵感来自日本浮世绘艺术。
但玩家很快发现美术画面存在不协调之处，部分玩家认为，这些问题表明游戏使用了效果低劣的AI处理。其中一张画面里的武士面部变成了金属纹理，脸与头盔几乎混在一起。玩家还指出，新增的分镜式过场动画也存在不协调的问题。
更糟的是，世嘉还停售了原版《全面战争：幕府将军2》，想玩的消费者只能购买新的完全版。原版游戏打折时往往只卖几美元，而这款重制版的售价为40美元（约合人民币268元）。
《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版目前在Steam上的用户评价为「差评如潮」，花了10美元（约合人民币67元）「升级」游戏的玩家纷纷表达不满。
Creative Assembly与世嘉在联合声明中表示：「我们知道，《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版既没有达到各位的期待，也未达到我们自己的标准。我们看到了大家的反馈、评论和评测。我们也认同，目前的游戏体验尚未达标。因此，我们正与平台方合作，下架这款游戏并恢复原版销售，同时调查这些问题。已经拥有游戏的玩家仍可访问并游玩。我们正与开发合作伙伴密切协作，查明这些问题的原因并落实改进，确保《全面战争：幕府将军2》完全版达到玩家对《全面战争》系列期待的质量标准。」
声明中的措辞将目光引向了波兰协作开发工作室Mataboo。该工作室参与过多款游戏的开发，从《黎明行者之血》到《自杀小队：杀死正义联盟》都有其身影。Creative Assembly即将推出的游戏还包括备受期待的《全面战争：战锤40K》和《异形：隔离2》。

title: CDPR新IP已开工，尚未进入预制作阶段
text:
凭借出色的《巫师》RPG系列和《赛博朋克2077》而闻名的波兰开发商CDPR，已经正式完成了一个供玩家游玩的全新世界的构想。其新IP《Project Hadar》的「世界观构想」阶段现已结束，团队正式开始将这些概念做成游戏。
联席首席执行官Michał Nowakowski表示：「这是我们迄今为止规模最大的一次尝试，花了我们数年时间。不过，如今我们可以说，对于这个世界及其核心要素，我们已经形成了一套连贯的构想。团队已经开始开发游戏，不过项目尚未进入预制作阶段。」
今年9月，CDPR表示正在为《Project Hadar》扩充人手，团队已有30多人，并计划「继续招聘，到今年年底将开发人员增至50人」。但这究竟是一款怎样的游戏？今年6月，一则新的招聘启事透露了些许线索：团队正在招募一名工程总监，协助「推动《Hadar》世界下一款沉浸式游戏的发展，打造一款情感丰富、令玩家难忘的开放世界体验」。开放世界，确认了！
当然，CDPR目前正全力开发《巫师4》。这是工作室接下来将推出的游戏，计划于2028年发售。不过，在此之前，《巫师3：狂猎》的第三部大型扩展《旧时曲》计划于明年推出。这部扩展由前CDPR开发者组成的Fool’s Theory团队开发，旨在衔接《巫师3》与系列下一部作品；后者将由杰洛特的养女希里担任主角。
之后还有《赛博朋克2077》的续作《赛博朋克2》。也别忘了，CDPR打算在六年内推出《巫师》新三部曲。假如《巫师4》能按计划于2028年发售，而且公司坚持这套雄心勃勃的新三部曲发行策略，我们或许会在2031年看到《巫师5》，在2034年看到《巫师6》。至于《Hadar》会排在其中哪个位置，现在谁也说不准。
我们对《Project Hadar》的世界和设定一无所知，但能看看CDPR这些才华横溢的开发者会构思出什么，想必很有意思——尤其是，这个世界在设计之初就会优先考虑如何承载一款规模庞大的RPG。不过，出于私心，我确实希望CDPR再做一款授权改编游戏。给我们一款优秀的《权力的游戏》电子游戏吧。拜托了。你们可以把它叫作《Project Hodor》。

title: LV将推出K/DA女团回归画集
text:
相关文章: K/DA社媒账号时隔六年更新
拳头游戏与时装品牌路易威登（LV）合作，将推出一本K/DA主题的Travel Book系列画集。这支《英雄联盟》女团刚宣布结束长达六年的休整、正式回归，画集的消息便随之公布。
《Tempo Point》将收录这支虚拟女团的全新插画，描绘「K/DA成员阿狸（主唱）、阿卡丽（说唱）、伊芙琳（主唱）和卡莎（主唱兼领舞／编舞）各自24小时的生活」。画集标准版和收藏版将于10月16日星期五在线上、部分LV门店及书店发售。
LV Travel Book是一个高端画集系列，收录世界各地艺术家的图像与插画作品。这本新画集将推出两个版本：标准版售价68美元（约合人民币455元），大开本收藏版售价245美元（约合人民币1640元）。两个版本收录的画作相同，均采用六色印刷、布面精装，封面采用丝网印刷工艺。
收藏版仅印制400册，将在LV官网、LV门店及部分书店发售。标准版也将通过上述渠道销售，并将在即将举行的2026《英雄联盟》全球总决赛粉丝嘉年华上展出。该活动定于11月12日至14日在纽约举行。
部分LV门店还将推出附赠独家黑胶唱片的限量签名版，这一版本总共仅有30册。
LV参与其中，乍看或许有些出人意料，但这家法国时装品牌其实一直与拳头游戏及这支虚拟女团保持合作。2019年，LV为《英雄联盟》全球总决赛官方打造了召唤师奖杯旅行硬箱。品牌女装艺术总监Nicolas Ghesquière曾为《英雄联盟》设计多款皮肤。在《MORE》的宣传期间，LV还为K/DA及为萨勒芬妮献声的特邀艺人刘柏辛提供了服装。
虚拟流行组合K/DA于2018年凭单曲《POP/STARS》出道，近日预告了自2020年以来的首次回归。K/DA在社交账号发布了一张图片，公布了这项新企划。图中展示了每位成员的眼睛，并配有「Start a Fire」的标语。完整企划将于10月20日揭晓。
Fortiche在也多个社交平台上与K/DA官方公告互动，暗示这家制作《英雄联盟：双城之战》的工作室可能为K/DA制作了新的动画音乐视频。

title: 索尼公布镀金版Walkman，售价5899美元
text:
相关文章: 索尼与 TCL 联手成立合资公司，剥离索尼电视业务
你有没有看着手机，心想：「这东西应该只能播放音乐，而且还得更闪亮一点？」好消息来了，索尼即将推出一款售价5899美元（约合人民币3.95万元）的Walkman，而且还是镀金的。这款型号为NW-WM1ZM3的播放器将于1月上市，目前已开放预购。
索尼表示，镀金不只是为了好看。官方公告写道：「NW-WM1ZM3采用精密加工的镀金无氧铜（OFC）机身，专为进一步提升这款旗舰机型的音质而设计。其主机身采用纯度为99.99%（4N）的无氧铜，背部机身也采用无氧铜。两者通过螺丝固定，螺丝采用本机型专属的低电阻镀金处理，确保接地连接稳定，从而带来强劲的低音、开阔的声场，以及顺滑且延展出色的高频表现。」
这款播放器还拥有35小时续航，配备5.5英寸屏幕，并采用索尼的DSD重制引擎（DSD Remastering Engine）来提升音质。这并不是索尼首款镀金Walkman；早在2022年，索尼就推出了售价3200美元（约合人民币2.14万元）的NW-WM1ZM2。

title: 动视确认《使命召唤》正开发全新子系列
text:
相关文章: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》「无人区：抢先体验」宣传视频
动视正在积极开发《使命召唤》的全新子系列，看来已准备暂时跳出《黑色行动》和《现代战争》这两个子系列。 还有更多相关内容 《使命召唤：现代战争4》DMZ模式也可抢先体验
动视首席营销官Tyler Bahl近日接受The Game Business采访时确认，旗下一家工作室正在开发《使命召唤》的全新子系列。Bahl没有透露负责开发的工作室，也未公布发售时间，但外界普遍认为，这就是Sledgehammer Games预计明年推出的下一款作品。他还指出，《现代战争4》将为Infinity Ward自2019年以来讲述的故事画上句号，不过他也暗示，未来仍可能围绕部分角色，在这一宇宙中继续讲述故事。
不过，动视认为，《使命召唤》未来的发展应更多依靠创新，而不是倚重既有子系列和熟悉的角色。
Bahl表示：「无论未来的游戏朝哪个方向发展，我们都必须创新。我们从玩家那里听到的是，他们想要新的、更好的，或是不一样的东西。我们身处的环境正在发生变化。你能看到新游戏一夜之间就做出来了，也能看到玩家的喜好和他们想要的游玩方式都在改变。」
这番话引发了人们对下一款《使命召唤》走向的种种猜测。开发团队会尝试把背景设在未来吗？还是遥远的过去？他们能引入怎样的机制，在不做太大改动的前提下带来新鲜感？《使命召唤》爆料人TheGhostofHope在2025年透露的一则传闻，或许能提供一些线索——前提是传闻属实。
据这则传闻，Sledgehammer的下一款游戏将着重展现武术，加入空手道踢技和手刀。Sledgehammer或许正尝试采用《疾速追杀》式的枪斗术，将爽快的枪战与流畅、华丽的近身搏斗结合起来。对于注重动作演出的第三人称游戏来说，这似乎更容易实现；但要在第一人称、快节奏的竞技游戏中实现这种玩法，可能会更困难。不过，如果能做成，或许会相当吸引人。
有趣的是，Sledgehammer Games刚开始参与《使命召唤》开发时，尝试的恰恰就是创新。这家工作室成立时，原本计划开发一款以越南战争为背景的第三人称《使命召唤》，利用团队开发《死亡空间》等游戏的经验，打造一种全新的《使命召唤》体验。后来Infinity Ward分崩离析，Sledgehammer被调去协助开发初版《现代战争3》，这个项目最终遭到取消。
尽管如此，Sledgehammer还是在首款独立负责开发的作品《高级战争》中再次尝试创新。游戏引入了外骨骼装甲，通过强化移动机制，让玩家能够跳跃、冲刺和滑行。这对《使命召唤》而言是一次大跨越，但玩家大多不接受将系列背景转向未来的尝试。此后，Sledgehammer的路线相当保守，开发了两款二战题材作品，以及另一款恰好也叫《现代战争3》的游戏，颇有些讽刺意味。
Sledgehammer Games能否再次拿出让玩家兴奋的作品，还有待观察。不过，时隔五年多，终于能迎来一款既不属于《现代战争》、也不属于《黑色行动》的作品，还是件好事。

title: 《Spine》自定义系统预告
text:
随心切换赤线的造型风格
用全新的战斗服饰装点自己，随心切换赤线的造型风格，更有多款出人意料的趣味服装等你体验。从严阵以待的战术装备，到吸睛炫酷的潮酷服饰，甚至还有一套鹦鹉装——多种选择，帮你打造出心目中的赤线。《Spine》将于2027年夏季登陆PS5、XBOX Series及PC平台。

title: 《跑车浪漫旅7》新版开场动画
text:
大型更新「Spec IV」第一部分现已推出
《跑车浪漫旅7》大型更新「Spec IV」第一部分现已推出。此次更新为游戏带来了全新的开场动画、六款各具特色的车型、一条新赛道、三份咖啡厅菜单等内容。

title: 《末世神枪》发售日预告
text:
与这片沉沦的国度共赴终局
旧南方已成焦土，但传奇未死，亦非生者。《末世神枪（Guns of Eschaton）》是一款类魂FPS游戏，背景设定于末世西部。洞悉猎杀你的怪物，精打细算每一发子弹，用火药与祷文锻造独属于你的战斗风格。无论是单枪匹马还是并肩作战，向西而行吧，枪客，与这片沉沦的国度共赴终局。游戏将于12月8日登陆PS5、XBOX Series及PC平台。

title: 《人类2》玩法概览预告
text:
融合不断演变的文化
在《人类2（HUMANKIND 2）》这款历史题材回合制策略游戏中，你将有机会建立一个跨越时代的文明。融合不断演变的文化，建设城市，统率军队，扩张帝国；随着气候变化重塑世界，你的历史进程与发展道路也将随之改变。游戏将登陆PC平台，具体发售日期待定。

title: 电影《养蜂人2》先导预告
text:
将于2027年1月15日登陆北美院线
亚当·克莱因此前的所作所为成为通缉犯。此时，他昔日所属、凌驾于政府之外的秘密组织「养蜂人」已经叛变，企图夺取美国政府控制权。前中情局局长韦斯特维尔德找上克莱，称只有他能阻止失控。克莱被迫重新出山，保护美国总统，并以机枪、火焰喷射器等火力对抗组织派来的杀手，展开一场前特工反噬自身组织的复仇行动。电影《养蜂人2》由《小人物2》导演提莫·塔哈亚托执导，杰森·斯坦森、杰瑞米·艾恩斯、庞·克莱门捷夫等人出演，将于2027年1月15日登陆北美院线。

title: 《重力回路2》试玩Demo宣传视频
text:
猎手军团随之而来
回路们曾带来和平……尽管和平并不长久。天空一度重归晴朗。直至一座全新的方舟突然现身，猎手军团也随之而来。「重力回路」凯发现自己再度面对一支近乎势不可挡的恐怖大军。所幸这一次，他不再是孤军奋战，因为「动力回路」凯博正与他并肩而战。两人强强联手，各展所长，凭借各自独特的战斗风格和专属战斗技艺，或许真能搏得一线生机，击退入侵者……《重力回路2》试玩Demo现已在Steam平台上线。

title: 剧集《弗里斯科之王》先导预告
text:
塞缪尔·杰克逊主演
《弗里斯科之王》为《塔尔萨之王》的衍生剧集，讲述塞缪尔·杰克逊饰演的拉塞尔原为纽约黑帮杀手，因拒绝刺杀恩人德怀特，前往弗里斯科另起炉灶。他看中郊区光鲜表象下的商机，招募年轻门徒、司机与各路伙伴，把小骗局和小生意逐步发展成犯罪帝国。随着势力扩张，风险、敌人与背叛不断升级，他必须始终快人一步，才能守住自己建立的「弗里斯科王国」。剧集将于12月18日在派拉蒙+播出。

title: 《2XKO》「莎弥拉」角色介绍
text:
将于10月27日参战
《2XKO》是一款免费游玩的格斗游戏，主打2v2游戏玩法和快速直观的操作。你可以单人操控双角色，也能拉上好友并肩作战。探索来自《英雄联盟》与《双城之战》的传奇英雄阵容，每位角色都拥有从MOBA灵感重塑、专为格斗而生的全新招式。「莎弥拉」将于10月27日加入《2XKO》参战阵容。

title: 《越过山丘》20分钟实机演示
text:
主机版要等到明年了
梦回越野黄金年代，探索广袤无垠天地。驾驶60至80年代的经典四驱车型，穿越充满挑战的崎岖小径。无论独自出发还是好友同行，都能悠然驰骋，尽情欣赏一路的壮美风光。《越过山丘（over the hill）》现已登陆PC平台，PS5、XBOX Series及Switch 2版本预计于2027年推出。

title: 史蒂文·索德伯格将接手《新蝙蝠侠2》拍摄工作
text:
相关文章: 《新蝙蝠侠2》片场照暗示猫头鹰法庭将出现
马特·里夫斯正在处理家庭事务，《十一罗汉》导演史蒂文·索德伯格已受聘完成《新蝙蝠侠2》的剩余拍摄。 还有更多相关内容 罗伯特·帕丁森：《新蝙蝠侠2》会走完全不同方向
本月早些时候有报道称，《新蝙蝠侠2》导演马特·里夫斯突然暂离项目，去处理私人事务。影片因此陷入了前景未明的尴尬境地，不过DC负责人Peter Safran近日向IGN表示，这个项目会完成。现在，我们知道影片将如何拍完了。华纳兄弟向Deadline确认，《十一罗汉》导演史蒂文·索德伯格将在这部超级英雄续作最后几周的拍摄中执导，完成剩余拍摄。
史蒂文·索德伯格
华纳兄弟的一位代表向Deadline表示：「马特·里夫斯仍在处理一件尚未解决的家庭事务。史蒂文·索德伯格很欣赏马特的作品，因此主动联系了他，将协助这位编剧兼导演完成《新蝙蝠侠2》最后几周的主体拍摄。马特和史蒂文将与演员及剧组密切合作，实现马特对这部电影的构想。」
在此过程中，索德伯格将直接与马特·里夫斯合作。Deadline记者Justin Kroll指出，里夫斯正在家中远程参与影片制作。影片杀青后，索德伯格会将工作交还给里夫斯，由后者负责后期制作。双方的目标是实现里夫斯对这部续作的原本构想，而不是让索德伯格拍出一部截然不同的电影。
索德伯格表示：「我觉得马特·里夫斯执导的《新蝙蝠侠》令人惊叹；他的创作意图明确，表达精准，整部作品严谨而连贯。我们这次的目标是与马特及其团队合作，拍出能与已有素材无缝衔接的镜头，让马特能够妥善完成自己的电影。」
目前尚不清楚此次停拍是否会导致影片再次延期。《新蝙蝠侠2》已经数次推迟上映，目前定于2028年2月上映。考虑到影片预计已没有太多内容需要拍摄，这次停拍或许不会严重影响制作进度。
索德伯格是一位效率颇高的导演，经常在制作中身兼数职。他以严格控制预算、拍摄速度快而闻名，在眼下的情况下，制片公司很可能会格外看重这些能力。他还曾获得奥斯卡最佳导演奖，这也为他增添了几分声望。
《新蝙蝠侠2》目前定于2028年2月18日上映。

title: 《控制：共振》三周销量破百万，Remedy发文庆祝
text:
相关文章: 《控制：共振》47分钟实机演示
《控制：共振》销量已达100万份，成为Remedy销售速度最快的游戏。尽管该作9月以数字版发售后，泄露者便将其破解并传播盗版，但仍取得了这一成绩。
Remedy于10月15日在X上发文庆祝这一里程碑：「感谢大家的支持。感谢大家游玩、分享，并成为社区的一员。」 还有更多相关内容 《控制：共振》评测
Remedy传播总监Thomas Puha也对此表示：「做到了。开局强劲。」
《控制：共振》的销售速度由此大幅超越《心灵杀手2》，后者此前保持着Remedy游戏销售速度最快的纪录。《心灵杀手2》这部经典续作用了两个月才达到100万份销量，而《控制：共振》仅用三周就达成了这一成绩。
这对Remedy和游戏粉丝而言都是好消息。该作9月下旬以数字版发售时，许多粉丝曾呼吁玩家不要下载盗版。不过，从目前的商业成绩来看，盗版似乎并未给开发商造成致命打击。而游戏实体版也刚刚推出，还有更多利润可期。
《控制：共振》获得了评测者与玩家的一致好评。IGN为其打出8分。评测者Michael Higham写道：「即便战斗最终不再那么精彩，《控制：共振》依然为Remedy宇宙增添了一部佳作。虽然故事采用了较为常规的框架，但围绕它构建的世界充满创意，对人物的刻画也让超自然谜团有了真实可感的根基，这些才是它的吸引力所在。」
事实上，这款游戏出色到让不少盗版用户放弃了非法下载，转而选择支持Remedy，希望游戏的成功能帮助工作室继续生存下去。一位粉丝在Reddit的盗版讨论版块写道：「这是少数几款我打算掏钱买的游戏之一。Remedy正濒临破产，这款游戏决定着他们的成败。我喜欢他们的游戏，得尽我所能帮他们撑下去。」另一位用户说：「我本来没打算买，但现在觉得应该买一份。我喜欢Remedy。他们做的游戏很好。」
Remedy以初代《控制》、《心灵杀手2》、《马克思·佩恩》和《量子破碎》等作品闻名。虽然这些作品深受玩家好评，却未必以迎合大众口味为目标，因此一些玩家担心这家开发商的未来。不过，从最新销量来看，Remedy的状况似乎还不错。

title: 美国议员提案保障数字游戏所有权
text:
相关文章: 索尼公布全黑版本PS5
美国民主党众议员Ritchie Torres提出法案，旨在确保玩家拥有自己购买的数字游戏，而不是仅仅买到允许游玩的许可。
这项名为《赋权玩家法案》（The Power to the Players Act）的提案，将要求美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）制定规定，保护玩家及其数字游戏库。简而言之，Torres希望确保玩家购买数字游戏后真正拥有它，而不是获得一份随时可能被撤销的许可。此外，法案还将要求在线游戏提供离线功能，让拥有游戏的玩家在服务器关闭后仍能游玩其中的内容。 还有更多相关内容 索尼新专利拟用玩家数据训练NPC
Torres在新闻稿中表示：「消费者必须有权拥有、游玩和转让自己购买的游戏。如果一家公司一停服，游戏就能被收走，那就不是买游戏，而是打着销售幌子的租赁。布朗克斯区乃至全美各地的家庭攒钱购买这些游戏，他们应得的不该只是一份随时可能消失的许可。《赋权玩家法案》将确保消费者拥有自己购买的游戏，即便公司早已不再支持游戏，他们也能继续游玩。」
Torres以《NBA 2K25》为例。该作近日宣布，服务器关闭后，单人模式也将无法游玩。这一消息引发广泛关注，许多人不解：一款才推出两年的游戏，为何这么快就要无法使用了。
Torres的法案针对的是游戏行业持续存在的争议。今年早些时候，PlayStation已确认将从2028年起放弃实体游戏，也就是说，从下一世代开始，玩家将无法真正拥有自己的游戏。《GTA6》今年11月发售时也不会推出实体版，因此发售后也不会有二手游戏可买。这是一个不断滑向更糟局面的趋势，而玩家与之抗争已有一段时间。
Stop Killing Games运动一直在争取让已经拥有游戏的玩家更容易继续游玩，即使游戏服务器已经关闭。Torres的法案将确保这一诉求得以实现，至少在美国如此。当然，这项法案最终能否通过，还要拭目以待。但这番努力值得肯定，也表明有人正在尝试推动改变。

title: 前总监Jeff Kaplan已彻底远离《守望先锋》
text:
相关文章: 《守望先锋》「血律」实机预告
前《守望先锋》游戏总监Jeff Kaplan解释了自己如何通过彻底远离有关这款暴雪英雄射击游戏的网络讨论和Reddit社区，来保护自己的心理状态。
如果你是一名《守望先锋》的忠实玩家，那么你很可能对Jeff Kaplan这个名字并不陌生。多年来，他几乎就是这款游戏的代言人，凭借定期发布的开发者更新，以及与玩家社区之间令人印象深刻的互动，赢得了粉丝的喜爱。
2021年离开暴雪后，Kaplan创立了自己的游戏开发工作室，目前正在开发一款名为《The Legend of California》的开放世界动作生存射击游戏。如今，他已经彻底放下了《守望先锋》，甚至到了尽可能避免在网上接触任何相关内容的程度。 还有更多相关内容 《守望先锋》开发者确认猎空仍是游戏吉祥物
Kaplan最近在接受GameSpot采访时表示：「对于《守望先锋》，我几乎是以一种非常理性、近乎临床式的方式与它彻底划清界限，因为我知道当年离开《魔兽世界》时是什么感受。从2021年4月开始，我就再也没有玩过这款游戏。为了自己的心理健康，我不会去看Reddit上的相关社区。在我向《守望先锋》竞技社区和Reddit社区告别之后，我就再也没有回去看过。我不看YouTube上的相关视频，不会搜索自己在《守望先锋》中的名字，也不会主动搜索《守望先锋》。我基本上就是彻底切断了与它的联系。我甚至会告诉所有推荐算法：『对，我现在真的对《守望先锋》没什么兴趣了。我知道你们觉得我是那个《守望先锋》的人，但这已经不再是我想关注的东西了。』」
Kaplan还告诉GameSpot，令人意外的是，当年离开《魔兽世界》团队、转而开发《守望先锋》，给他带来的痛苦实际上比后来告别《守望先锋》还要强烈。他将那段经历称为一次「训练」，让自己学会如何迈向职业生涯的下一阶段。
他解释道：「在那个时候，《魔兽世界》就是我的全部。我把所有时间、所有清醒着的时间都投入了《魔兽世界》。如果我没有在开发《魔兽世界》，那我就是在玩《魔兽世界》。而且每次玩游戏时，我都会在桌子旁边放一个记事本，一边玩一边把问题记下来。这样第二天早上走进办公室时，我就可以告诉大家：『这些就是我们需要修改的所有东西。』所以，当我离开《魔兽世界》时，那种情绪上的负面冲击真的让我非常震惊。因为它已经成为我自身的一部分，也深深影响着我如何认识自己。它就是我作为一名游戏开发者的身份。」
在付出代价后，Kaplan终于明白，自己参与开发的游戏并不属于自己，而是暴雪拥有的IP。有了这个认识，他后来就更容易继续向前走了。他说：「《守望先锋》诞生了，我曾经是其中的一员。但现在那里已经有了另一支团队，《守望先锋》如今属于他们。无论是玩家还是开发者，现在那都是他们的《守望先锋》。他们在制作它，他们拥有它，他们也在玩它。而我已经开始做新的事情了。这就是我现在人生所处的阶段。」
自从将近五年前离开暴雪以来，Kaplan也一直没有回避发表自己对当前游戏行业的看法。最近，他还对那些抱怨自己根本不会去玩的游戏的玩家说了一番相当严厉的话。他说：「如果一款游戏推出了，你不想玩，而且你从来都没玩过？那他妈就闭嘴吧。根本没人在乎。」
此外，今年3月，Kaplan还透露了自己当初真正离开暴雪的原因，并谈到一场特定的会议。他将那次经历形容为「我整个职业生涯中最让我觉得被狠狠羞辱的一刻」。

title: Steam推出全新「成就集合」功能
text:
相关文章: Steam半年利润110亿美元，老游戏占近八成
Valve正在为Steam成就系统引入一项重要新功能，名为「成就集合」（Achievement Sets）。该功能允许开发者将游戏本体和DLC的成就划分为不同组别，分别进行展示。
Valve表示：「在支持成就集合的游戏中，您仍旧是通过像平常一样玩游戏来解锁成就。但是在您之后浏览已解锁的成就时，Steam 会将长长的游戏成就列表按开发者创建的成就集合进行划分，这样您就能更轻松地查看已达成的成就，并找到接下来可以解锁的其他相关成就。」 还有更多相关内容 Gabe Newell否认Steam垄断指控：玩家选择多
每个成就组都有独立的进度条。如果玩家完成某个成就组，还会获得一座「成就组完成」奖杯，并可以在个人资料页面展示。Steam还将支持季节性成就组，开发者可以在活动结束后将其归档。Valve表示：「我们认为，游戏可以通过多种有趣的方式来利用这种功能给成就带来的时效性，比如给按赛季开展的游戏添加成就，或是启用限时节日成就等。」
根据Valve公布的信息，目前已有部分游戏支持成就组功能，包括：
- 《风暴之城》
- 《奇迹时代4》
- 《美国卡车模拟》
- 《使命召唤：现代战争4》
- 《十字军之王3》
- 《渔帆暗涌》
- 《欧洲卡车模拟2》
- 《极限竞速：地平线5》
- 《Flock Around》
- 《魔王将至》
- 《乐高蝙蝠侠：黑暗骑士之遗》
- 《求生之路2》
- 《传送门2》
- 《冲就完事模拟器》
- 《冲就完事模拟器2》
- 《军团要塞2》
- 《维多利亚3》
此外，Valve还将重新设计Steam成就页面，展示「玩家整体成就进度的汇总、各个成就组的完成进度，以及单项成就的详细信息」。Valve称：「您将在个人资料的最新动态部分、游戏列表、Steam 库等等区域看到自己已完成的集合。」
通过家庭共享玩过的游戏现在会显示在游戏列表中，通过家庭共享获得游戏时长的好友现在也可以参与好友间的比较，商店和库中的游戏页面现在也将显示该游戏是否拥有成就集合。
这些新的成就功能现已在最新的Steam客户端测试版中上线。

title: 《霜港迷城》1.0正式版发售宣传视频

每一个决策都至关重要
《霜港迷城（Frosthaven）》作为《幽港迷城》的精神续作将带玩家进入严酷而危险的北境世界，无论是桌游老玩家还是电子游戏爱好者，都能在这里找到归属感！在游戏中，全新角色职业各具独特的玩法和能力，使得每一个决策都至关重要。玩家需要在风险与回报之间仔细权衡，打造最优职业搭配，实现团队协作的最大化。合理规划资源，将是推进这场史诗战役的关键。在广阔而危机四伏的世界中，迎战强敌，书写属于你的冒险篇章吧！《霜港迷城》1.0正式版现已登陆PC平台。

text:

1499年，法国首都巴黎遭到突如其来的魔物袭击。萝斯‧贝尔蒙特为了查明这场灾厄的元凶，开始在市街讨伐魔物并展开探索。《恶魔城：贝尔蒙特的诅咒》现已登陆PS5、XBOX Series、Switch及PC平台。

text:
艾泽拉斯重获新生

text:
对一部古老传说的深情重述

text:

title: IGN 中国《恐龙猎人：起源》专访：不会做成服务型游戏
text:
相关文章: 《恐龙猎人：起源》试玩前瞻：支持 FPS 与 TPS 切换的买断制射击｜IGN 中国
今年 TGS 期间，我们在幕张展馆旁的酒店会议室里试玩了《恐龙猎人：起源（Turok: Origins）》的闭门 Demo，试玩心得可以看 这篇前瞻文章 。试玩之后，我们以邮件形式对开发商 Saber Interactive 进行了采访，围绕重启这个 IP 的理由、双视角的实现方式、买断制之下的长期价值等角度。
以下为本次采访内容整理。 还有更多相关内容 《恐龙猎人 起源》剧情预告 | gamescom 2026
IGN 中国：距离《恐龙猎人》上一款作品发售已经很久了，为什么现在重启这个系列？
Saber Interactive： 《恐龙猎人》IP 有很多元素本身就很有潜力：打恐龙、打外星人、穿越太空、时间旅行、原住民文化，还有血腥激烈的战斗。老粉丝等着重回失落之地，已经等得够久了；我们相信新玩家也会喜欢上它。
IGN 中国：为什么加入第一人称和第三人称切换功能？毕竟同类作品有这样设计的几乎没有。
Saber Interactive： 第一人称是必须的 —— 那是对系列根源的尊重，也是最能把沉浸感和激烈程度拉满的打法。新增第三人称，是为了适应今天的玩家，同时让平台跳跃和探索更容易操作。两种视角能无缝切换，玩家就可以按当下的情况自己选。
IGN 中国：切换视角后，角色的闪避等动作会有不同性能吗？
Saber Interactive： 两套视角用的是完全不同的制作管线。比如闪避，第三人称是翻滚，第一人称是冲刺。玩法上没有任何区别。
IGN 中国：在设计不同的恐龙时，如何让玩家感受到“这是一只恐龙”，而不是一般的怪物？开发过程中你们觉得哪只恐龙的动作是最难设计的？
Saber Interactive： 我们的设计和美术团队是拿真实恐龙考古资料做参考的，用它来塑造这些生物的行为和解剖结构，让它们有真实感，再往上叠《恐龙猎人》的那些招牌科幻元素。
花了不少心思动画团队在参考资料和打磨上花了不少心思，以保证生物和人形角色的动作捕捉都足够真实。在动作和行为上比较复杂的一只是 Marauder（掠夺者）—— 我们想办法把“恐惧”这个东西做进了它潜行、捕猎和伏击玩家的方式里。
IGN 中国：DNA 机制对游戏的剧情和故事发展有什么意义吗？
Saber Interactive： 《恐龙危机》对动植物 DNA 的共鸣是战役叙事里的一条主线。Xenia（注：反派组织，包含恐龙和外星势力等）和图洛克骑士团（Turok）都在用 DNA，但目的完全相反：Xenia 吸收并腐化环境与野生动物，吞食它们、让它们屈从于自己的意志；图洛克则保护、敬畏自然，用得到的能力守护人类。
从立项开始，我们就认为骑士团和他们所处的环境是不可分割的。这让“操纵 DNA”成了故事里的核心概念 —— 它同时决定了双方的战斗方式、外围的成长系统，还有其他很多东西。它渗透进了游戏的每一个特性，玩法本身也反映了这一点。受影响的不仅是进阶系统，还有其他元游戏层面的内容和视觉表现。
IGN 中国：DNA 系统能从多大程度上决定玩家的打法？同一个职业用不同的 DNA，会产生完全不同的 Build 吗？
Saber Interactive： 进阶系统分进攻型和防御型，玩家可以靠它自定义配装，调整自己的游戏体验。想打激进的近身战，可以装“碾压震波”（Crushing Tremors），制造一次强力冲击波，把范围内的敌人全打一遍；要控场的话，“时间扰乱器”（Time Disruptor）会生成一个时间气泡，把敌人减速。每个配装最多带 2 个进阶系统，所以组合和协同非常多。
（记者注：进阶系统 EchoSyncs，即玩家从敌人与环境提取的 DNA 所转化的技能槽。）
IGN 中国：为什么选择三人合作，而不是双人、四人、五人？游戏最初的难度和 Boss 战是为了单人考虑，还是以多人为基础设计？
Saber Interactive： 难度平衡上，我们优先考虑的是单人体验。玩家选择单人还是合作、以及不同难度时，游戏会根据队伍人数去调整敌人的数量、血量、行为和攻击性。两到三个人能产生最好的协同，三个职业也是围绕这个来设计的。
我们希望队里每个人的影响力都足够大，让自己的战斗决策真的有意义。三人小队之下，整体危险度和个人责任都会更高。
IGN 中国：很多同类游戏都采用了 GaaS 模式（服务型游戏、长线更新），但本作是一款传统买断制游戏。在没有长期运营的情况下，你们希望玩家通关之后从这款游戏中获得什么样的长期价值？
Saber Interactive： 《起源》有一个相当庞大的终局部分：主线完成之后，还有支线任务、改造过的任务和挑战可以打。主线战役本身也能重玩，去把关卡探索透、把隐藏奖励收集齐。
《恐龙猎人：起源》将于 2027 年春季发售，登陆 PS5、Xbox Series X|S、Switch 2 与 PC（Steam／Epic）。
本文由 IGN 中国原创撰写，原作者 Zacky Zhang，未经授权禁止转载。

title: 一文读懂 RTX Spark：它到底是什么，游戏玩家应该怎么看待？
text:
NVIDIA 在中国台北的 Computex 上发布了一款全新超级芯片：RTX Spark。黄仁勋表示，这颗芯片将是“Windows PC的全新开始”。
采用 RTX Spark 芯片的产品已于 10 月 16 日正式发售。在产品正式上市之前，NVIDIA 把全球的头部科技媒体都拉到了旧金山，让大家提前体验了这批新设备与原有的 Windows PC 到底有什么不同。
RTX Spark 到底是什么？
关注 NVIDIA 近几年动向的读者或许还记得一款叫 DGX Spark 的产品，它是一台跑着 Linux 系统的迷你 AI 超级计算机，主要卖给开发者用于跑本地大模型。而 RTX Spark 既不是某个具体笔记本电脑的名称，也不是 DGX Spark 的Windows 版换壳，可以理解为一套面向笔记本电脑与紧凑型桌面主机的 Windows 平台，基于 ARM 架构运行。
RTX Spark 超级芯片，配备了最高 6144 个 CUDA Core 的 Blackwell RTX GPU、20 核 Grace CPU、第五代 Tensor Core 和第四代 RT Core，并且最高可配备 128GB LPDDR5X 统一内存，其中笔记本版本的芯片功耗范围为 45W 至 80W，桌面端则可到 140W。NVIDIA 官方给出的 AI 指标为最高 1 PFLOPS FP4 性能。
这一堆参数里最关键的是“统一内存”。
传统高性能 Windows PC 的运行逻辑是分工：CPU 用系统内存，GPU 用自己的显存，二者之间通过 PCIe 传输数据。但进入了本地 AI、视频生成、3D 场景和多智能体并行工作后，显存容量很快会成为上限。导致模型装不下，意味着要换更小的量化版本、拆分任务，或者数据上云端。
RTX Spark 的方案则是让 CPU 和 GPU 采用最高达 128GB 的统一内存，让一台轻便 Windows 设备获得了过去很难想象的模型装载空间。128G 统一内存是什么概念？它支持处理 90GB 级 3D 场景与 12K 4:2:2 视频工作流，或者本地跑 200B 参数的大模型。但对游戏方面意义有限：现在连 16GB 显存都吃不饱，128GB 统一内存提升有限。
过去几年，AI PC 的叙事常常停在 NPU：摄像头虚化、会议降噪、离线翻译、系统摘要……它们有价值，却很难改变用户对“Windows 电脑”的基本理解。所以 NVIDIA 的“野心”就很明显了：让“本地可运行的大模型”变成 PC 的常态能力，而不是一切都交给云端，用户再花一笔钱去买 Token。首先让一个能读取文件、调用工具、写代码、处理素材的智能体留在本机运行，对于要反复跑图、生成视频、写代码和整理资料的用户来说，这意味着更少的按次付费、更少的上传等待，也意味着不必把私人素材和未公开项目交给远端服务。
当然，也不是说拥有 RTX Spark 设备就意味着 AI 自由：硬件本身、电费消耗、存储空间和模型下载都是成本，而本地模型的能力显然也无法追上不断进化的云端模型。更合理的用法是，把高频、私密、重复且可容忍一定推理时间的任务留在本地，再把真正困难的“大问题”交给云端。
接下来看看芯片本身。
RTX Spark 芯片是一体两面的，一侧是全新的 Grace 架构 CPU，另一侧是 Blackwell 架构 GPU，两块芯片以 NVLink-C2C 封装熔在一起。NVLink-C2C 提供了 600 GB/s 的双向带宽，能以更高效的方式传输 CPU 与 GPU 之间的数据，且显著节能。
降低功耗的目的当然不仅仅是省钱或是环保这么简单：搭载了 RTX Spark 芯片的笔记本，能在较低的功耗前提下维持基本接近插电状态的性能。NVIDIA 工程师表示这个差异约为 1%，可以忽略不计。
笔记本电脑行业几十年都有着“离电即残血”的默认规则。典型轻薄本电池只能供 100W 左右，游戏本离电时性能腰斩再腰斩，Windows 掌机用户应该对这一点理解颇深。而 RTX Spark 的整套设计就是为了让整机在 80W也能跑满，剩下的电留给屏幕和硬盘。也就是说，用户在飞机上、咖啡馆里或是任何没法插电的地方，跑渲染、打游戏、运行 AI，性能几乎不打折。
如何理解“Windows PC 的全新开始”？
NVIDIA 在现场分享了两个数据：第一，今年还没过完，但开源模型下载量已经达到了去年的五倍；第二，本地模型的智能水平追赶前沿模型的周期，已经从十六个月压缩到几个月 —— 四月份还只能跑在数据中心的最新模型，现在可以直接塞进笔记本了。
这些都意味着本地大模型已经逐渐来到了“够用”的阶段。这也是 NVIDIA 和微软为什么会在现在合作，推出这样一系列产品。
就像微软曾经给 ROG Xbox Ally X 掌机做了一套底层软件，Windows 也为 RTX Spark 适配了一些新东西。
一、新机设置流程里嵌了引导，几次点击就能装好一个本地 AI 智能体，首发包含 Hermes、OpenClaw 和 Perplexity，通过走微软商店分发，支持自动更新。
二、微软给智能体造了个叫“执行容器”的概念：每个智能体在系统层面被隔离成一台电脑上的“另一个用户”，它们有自己的身份和权限，能读取用户文档，但碰不到系统文件。在此之上，NVIDIA 还会再叠一层 OpenShell，管理网络访问和凭证保护，确保不会过度放权。
三、智能路由。简单的任务本地运行，遇到不好解决的复杂推理，系统会自动把请求升级到云端大模型，再把结果交还本地。以用户视角来说，本地和云的边界基本可以忽略不计了。
软件层面的优化，让 RTX Spark 设备不仅是一台具备高本地算力的 AI PC，毕竟模型留在本机只能减少数据外发，真正让用户担心的还是这个能操作浏览器、命令行和文件系统的智能体，到底安不安全。
对创意工作者来说，RTX Spark 也有一些独到的优势。这台设备能同时处理 3D、视频、直播、图像生成和 AI 工作流。
限制创意工作者的往往不是硬件性能本身，而是复杂的工作流和有限的时间 —— 横跨 Photoshop、Premiere、Blender、Substance 3D、Unreal Engine 和各类生成工具，反复切换软件、找资产、确认参数、等待预览。RTX Spark 则是希望让本地智能体和 RTX 加速共同完成这些工作，比如让智能体根据指令调用已有工具，把一张插画推进成 3D 场景、换镜头、生成素材，再交回熟悉的创作软件继续精修。
Adobe 已宣布为 RTX Spark 优化 Photoshop、Premiere 和 Substance 3D。以 Photoshop 为例：“移除”功能完全本地运行，离线一键抹掉画面里的路人；滤镜全部实时渲染于画布；甚至可以让 AI 即时生成全新的滤镜，做完还能直接分享。
Blender 5.3 将在 11 月发布支持 DLSS 4.5 光线重建的测试版，实时拖动观察光线追踪渲染成为现实。
视频生成方面，本地就能跑 LTX 2.5，生成次数无限、无需订阅、不按条数计费、不用排队，出片不满意就再次“抽卡”。现场还演示了 4:2:2 的 Log 素材本地调色、生成，全程笔记本离电运行。
国内用户很熟悉的、来自腾讯的智能体 WorkBuddy 也将针对 RTX Spark 推出专项优化，软件内即可直接下载本地大模型，现场的演示也吸引了不少媒体围观。
游戏玩家有什么值得期待的？
先说结论：RTX Spark 并不着眼于替代GeForce GPU。
它保留了完整 RTX 游戏栈：硬件光线追踪、DLSS、Reflex、G-SYNC、Game Ready 驱动、RTX Remix。根据官网信息，RTX Spark 可在 1440p、开启光追、DLSS 和 Reflex 的条件下，让 3A 游戏实现 100fps 以上的帧数运行，现场也展示了刚刚发售的《战争机器：事变日》，使用了 Dell XPS RTX Spark，以 1600p、中档画面的运行，实际帧数 90 上下。
但 RTX Spark 的定位依旧是“能开光追跑 3A 的轻薄本”，而不是游戏本。
DLSS 帧生成把帧数提升到能接受的水平，3D引导神经网络渲染再补回画面细节，6144 核心的 GPU原生性能也相当强劲，但它 300 GB/s 的内存带宽比起桌面端RTX GPU相对弱一些，还要拖着一套经模拟层翻译的 CPU 侧代码。
不过得益于 DLSS 5 的高效更新，这块芯片还是很值得期待的。九月上线的3D引导神经网络渲染能在实时画面里直接生成光照和材质细节，十月的更新把 DLSS 5 模型提速两倍，接下来还会有《霍格沃茨之遗》《魔兽世界：永恒》《燕云十六声》《永恒之塔 2》提供 DLSS 5 补丁升级。
另一个考量是，RTX Spark 采用 Grace ARM CPU，而今天绝大多数 Windows 游戏仍以 x86-64 为主。Windows 的 Prism 负责 x64 应用的 CPU 指令翻译，GPU 端的 DX12、光追和 DLSS 则可以直接调用。
现场的问答环节中，微软也承认了兼容性问题：跑在游戏进程里的反作弊都可以通过模拟解决，但内核级反作弊需要厂商针对 ARM 适配，这使得部分联网游戏的适配可能会受到影响。
好消息是 NVIDIA 已经采取行动了，并且解决了很多问题。今年科隆游戏展期间，NVIDIA 宣布与 EA 合作，将把原生 Javelin 反作弊带上 Spark，《F1 25》《Apex 英雄》位列名单；微软侧确认《使命召唤》将于 2027 年提供支持，《魔兽世界：午夜》十一月同步推出；Epic 的 EAC 支持包现已适配《堡垒之夜》。
单机游戏方面，微软 DirectX 团队已提供了“高级着色器交付”：游戏下载完成点击启动，着色器自动编译交付，一气呵成。这项技术已在 ROG 掌机验证，现在带到了 RTX Spark 平台。
所以，纯玩家身份如果想要入手 RTX Spark，更应该把它理解成一台“具备 RTX 游戏技术栈的 ARM Windows PC”，而不是独显的替代品。尤其是依赖内核级反作弊的在线游戏，还是要查查目标游戏的原生支持、反作弊状态和实测表现。
它适合你吗？
NVIDIA 在官网给 RTX Spark 产品按内存分成了 Essential、Advanced 和 Ultimate（基础、高级、终极）三档，基本是以内存区分。其中 32G 的基础版可以安装 25B 以内的本地大模型，但更多复杂任务就要依赖云端了；64G 的高级版是“个人 token 工厂”的起点，本地模型上限 90B，也能渲染 45GB 规模的 3D 场景；最贵的终极版支持本地跑 200B 参数的 FP4 量化版大模型，多个智能体并行也不会受到干扰，是预算不敏感用户的一步到位的选择。
官方对 RTX Spark 的功能定义十分清晰：这是一台兼具创意制作、本地 AI 和游戏娱乐三者的综合设备。如果是纯游戏玩家，采购这样的设备显然是略有浪费的；但对于有本地大模型需求、日常使用创意工作流且希望能兼顾日常娱乐的用户，它确实提供了另一种一站式解决方案。
目前，微软 Surface、华硕、戴尔、惠普、联想和微星等 OEM 品牌的 RTX Spark 笔记本产品已陆续公布，国内用户也可以关注京东等渠道的后续销售与价格信息。
除了笔记本外，还有类似 DGX Spark 大小的紧凑型桌面终端，与笔记本同样是统一内存和 ARM 架构，但目前配置等信息还没完全公布，似乎上市也要再晚些。这也是我个人最感兴趣的设备 —— 买一台放在电视旁，日常挂着本地大模型随时远程调用，下班了作为高配版 Steam Machine 打打游戏，想想就非常安逸。
回到黄仁勋所说的“Windows PC 的全新开始”，RTX Spark 展示了一个值得关注的方向：当 AI 不再只是应用里的一个功能，而成为个人电脑长期运行的基础能力时，Windows PC 的下一次变化，可能就不只是更快的处理器或更强的显卡了。

title: 本周 Steam 值得关注的游戏 10.12 - 10.18（四）
text:
第三部分
注： 本系列文章的信息主要整合自 Steam 与 SteamDB 的即将发售列表，由于 Steam 支持手动输入日期及发售、同步不及时等原因，本列表可能会遗漏收录一些作品的发售信息。如果本周有您的作品或您喜欢的作品未被列出，欢迎直接评论补充链接～～
EarthX 2
关键字： 太空模拟、自动化、采矿
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）EA
创办并经营自己的航天公司。发射可重复使用的火箭，完成任务，运营卫星互联网。管理工厂和旗下航天器，为月球与火星殖民地提供补给，逐步推进火星的地球化改造。
链兽角斗（Chained Beasts）
关键字： 动作类 Rogue、合作
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）
《链兽角斗》是一款支持 1–4 名玩家合作的角斗士类 Roguelike 游戏。与你的伙伴相互锁链，在混乱的战斗中并肩作战。利用锁链或竞技场，以创造性的方式击败敌人，赢得嗜血观众的欢呼。忍受身体与精神的创伤，打倒强大的首领，活到最后一刻。
侦探杀：罪恶之城（Dupery: A Game of Solo Deduction）
关键字： 社交推理、类 Rogue、调查
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）
《侦探杀：罪恶之城》是一款主打单机体验的社会派推理 Roguelite 游戏，你需要在每起案件中识别证人们的真话与谎言，推敲他们的身份与动机，并巧用不同证人的独特身份技能，协助你排除干扰，梳理思路，直捣邪恶辛迪加的老巢。
Fatal Train
关键字： 社交聚会游戏、推理、黑色幽默
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）
列车上出了命案？无所谓，那已经不归我们管了！女士们，先生们，别担心，我们有四位侦探能搞定这件事！毕竟，查个凶杀案能有多难，对吧？
Odd Town
关键字： 探索、开放世界、沙盒
发行日期： 2026/10/16（暂无中文）
《奇异小镇》是一款第一人称叙事冒险游戏，讲述了玩家被困在一个一切都显得有些不对劲的小镇上的故事。探索这座精心打造、规模适中的小镇，结识可疑的当地居民，接些零工，躲避警察，成为阴谋论者，还能顺手偷几个三明治。
Tales of Eternia Remastered
关键字： 日系角色扮演、动作
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）
永远和羁绊的 RPG，《Tales of Eternia》以 Remastered 复出！世界毁灭的危机逼近，伊菲利亚与塞雷斯迪亚，赌上两世界命运的壮阔旅行，现在启程。
爱丽丝与彼岸（Alice Nation）
关键字： 卡牌游戏、剧情丰富、自选历险体验
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）
坠入可爱童话风的彼岸世界，展开一场桌面上的跑团冒险。在这款交互式叙事卡牌游戏中，扮演困在彼岸的少女爱丽丝，探索由卡牌构筑的场景，解决难题与敌人，寻找重返现实的办法。
破灭的御宅族（Doomed Otaku）
关键字： 剧情丰富、黑色喜剧、视觉小说
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）
「网络世界中也有真正的朋友！」 「毁灭的御宅族」是一款讲述徘徊中的 20 多岁御宅族，在现实与网络两个世界中穿梭并体验各种事件的多结局冒险游戏。
Dreadline Express
关键字： 心理恐怖、推理、探索、选择取向
发行日期： 2026/10/16（ 中文支持 ）

title: 数据越好，团队越不敢创新？Zynga创始人讲透了这个困境
text:
2012年，Zynga曾有机会以4亿美元现金收购Supercell。
按照Zynga创始人Mark Pincus的回忆，他与Supercell联合创始人Ilkka Paananen已经达成口头意向，但交易遭到董事会反对，他最终选择退让。多年后，他把这次错失机会归因于自己当时缺少足够的信心，也过于倾向防守。
在近期接受Deconstructor of Fun访谈时，Pincus围绕新书《Life at the Speed of Play》，回顾了自己的产品与管理经历。从如何放弃失败创意，到数据驱动团队为何不敢创新，再到创始人应该把时间花在哪里。
他的表达很直接，甚至带有强烈的自我批评。罗斯基整理了其中对游戏从业者有参考价值的部分，以下为编译内容：
4亿美元的机会，为什么没能抓住？
按照Pincus在访谈中的回忆，2012年他曾与Supercell联合创始人Ilkka Paananen达成口头收购意向，Zynga准备支付4亿美元现金。当时《卡通农场》已经给Zynga带来竞争压力，《部落冲突》也刚刚上线。
Pincus说，团队非常关注Supercell，大家都在玩它的游戏，但最终没有买下这家公司。这里面的阻力来自Zynga董事会。
此前，Zynga花费约2亿美元收购《你画我猜》开发商OMGPOP，结果不理想。这次失败让董事会对下一笔交易更加谨慎。他们给Pincus的回应是：先证明你能管理好已有业务，再考虑收购其他公司。
Pincus仍然拥有投票控制权，也曾向律师咨询强行推进的可能性。律师告诉他，这可能意味着解散并重组董事会，还要面对诉讼。他最终没有走到那一步。
如今再回头看，Pincus认为自己当时缺少足够的信心，也不愿同时对抗董事会和华尔街，于是放弃了一次自己看好的机会。
当然，这是多年后的个人复盘。口头意向距离完成交易仍有诸多环节，Supercell被收购后能否取得后来的成绩，也无法验证。但Pincus真正后悔的，是此前的失败改变了自己的决策方式。
这种防守心态延续到了2015年。
重返首席执行官岗位时，Zynga仍持有约14亿美元现金。他推动裁员、修复老产品，并投入8亿美元回购股票。回购取得了不错的回报，他却认为，自己那时把太多精力放在处理过去的损失上，没能充分利用手中的资源寻找新机会。
从那时起Pincus逐渐意识到，一次失败的影响，可能远超那笔亏损。它会让管理者下意识地回避风险，即使下一次机会已经摆在眼前。
最危险的项目，可能是那个还不错的项目
Pincus用一个颇具冲击力的说法区分直觉与方案——你的直觉可能95%的时候是对的，但具体想法的正确率，最多只有25%。
2003年，他就想过用短信叫出租车。
演出散场遇到下雨时，用户可以提前在座位上发出请求，出门便有车等着。需求确实存在，但他设想的实现方式是向出租车中介提供服务，再由中介推广给乘客。技术、时机和商业模式都没有对上。
容易困住团队的，恰恰是那些得到一点反馈、却始终没有真正打中的项目。Pincus把它们称为B+产品：方向可能有价值，当前方案却不够好。少量积极信号足以让团队继续投入，也足以让创始人不断为自己的想法辩护。
相比之下，完全没有反馈的项目反而容易判断。
这里面的困难在于，团队必须承认某个方案行不通，同时继续寻找满足同一需求的其他路径。被市场误解与判断错误之间，有时只有一线之隔。创始人的坚持需要事实支撑，否则很容易变成对自身故事的迷恋。
所以Pincus将产品拆成三个部分：已经验证的基础、做得更好的细节，以及全新的尝试。
游戏是理解这套方法的好例子。
三消、跑酷和塔防已经经过多年市场检验，开发者可以先确认这些玩法为什么有效，再考虑自己能在哪些地方提高体验。更少的操作、更好的美术、更低的价格，都可能比宏大的新系统更让用户在意。
新鲜设计则负责吸引用户尝试，但用户是否留下，仍取决于核心体验。
Pincus在Zynga反复强调，新尝试应该默认有很高的失败概率。团队需要带着这种预期做验证，避免把资源配置建立在乐观想象上。有证据支撑的信念，与单纯希望事情成功，是两种不同状态。前者来自数据和已验证的经验，后者更多来自愿望。
产品团队越早分清两者，越容易及时放弃无效方案。
数据驱动的公司，也会被数据困住
看似矛盾的是，Pincus一边强调新创意容易失败，一边又要求团队必须冒险——因为游戏业务会自然衰退。
常规优化可以延缓下滑，却未必带来下一轮增长。当Facebook或苹果调整平台规则时，依靠原有方法维持业务也可能越来越困难。
但高度关注投入产出的团队，通常更愿意选择确定的小收益。优化一个已有功能，可能带来5%的日活增长；尝试全新玩法，则可能消耗大量研发资源却毫无回报。久而久之，公司擅长修补今天，却不再投资未来。
为打破这种惯性，Zynga要求团队每季度至少开展一次足够大胆的产品尝试，将其写入目标管理体系。Pincus也把研发工时作为约束：如果投入增长功能和大胆尝试的研发时间低于25%，就意味着公司过度消耗现有成果。
大胆尝试仍然需要控制成本。
在完整开发前，团队可以先测试入口，观察用户是否愿意点击。他举出的一个验证思路是，先寻找能吸引约25%用户点击的方向，再决定是否继续投入。这套机制的作用，是让创新在日常优化之外获得明确的位置。
否则，即使所有人都认可创新，排期时也很容易把它推到下个季度。
老板不在场时，团队能否自己作出正确决定？
Pincus对公司扩张的定义是：当你不在房间里，其他人仍然能把事情做对。领导者需要明确结果，给团队足够空间自行寻找方法。
成员可以采用与老板不同的方案，只要最终实现了共同认可的目标。Zynga曾鼓励员工像首席执行官一样思考，对结果负责。Pincus认为，管理者应该为成员提供足够大的任务，也在他们完成任务后给予相应的责任和回报。
为了避免这一模式演变成创始人一言堂，Pincus强调要让最接近数据和事实的人发声。这些人可能距离决策权最远，却掌握着最重要的信息。当员工判断正确、领导者判断错误时，公司应该公开认可前者。
只有这样，团队才会相信争论确实有意义。
在产品落地层面，投资人Bing Gordon曾检查Pincus的日程，要求他至少将50%的时间用于产品和产品团队。、如果创始人本身最擅长产品，也最能推动团队，却把大部分时间用于投资人沟通和对外活动，公司就浪费了最重要的一项资源。
在他看来，服务投资人的有效方式，是做出几年后仍有价值的产品。日程表比口头承诺更能说明一个人重视什么。
访谈最后，Pincus给产品团队的建议是，围绕明确的长期方向，持续调整具体方案，同时多观察外部世界。
他甚至建议把80%的时间用于寻找外部线索，只留下20%研究自己的想法。因为当团队一门心思想让当前方案成功时，很容易错过别人已经找到的答案。 返回搜狐，查看更多

title: 从创意原型到上线两月内购月入25万美元，休闲游戏《BagMaster Isekai》经历了什么？
text:
今年3月，一款融合背包管理、肉鸽成长和回合制战斗的手游《BagMaster Isekai》正式面向全球发行。
根据AppMagic数据，3月至5月，该作上线两个月的时间，月内购收入从2.6万美元增长至25万美元，月下载量也从32万攀升至80万以上。随后，《BagMaster Isekai》入围了LEVEL UP KL期间举办的2026东南亚游戏大奖。
这些成绩背后，是一家起步时只有4名成员的越南工作室。
对于亚洲中小团队来说，全球化经常伴随着一道难题：既要保留产品最初的创意，又要补齐数据分析、市场投放和全球运营等能力。团队规模越小，这种压力越明显。
《BagMaster Isekai》开发商Doors Studio给出的解法，是将自身的产品判断与SayGames的全球发行能力结合起来。工作室继续专注玩法和内容，发行商则提供数据、测试以及商业化等方面的支持。
罗斯基近期了解到Doors Studio及《BagMaster Isekai》背后的研发故事，在这里与大家做一下分享：
从4个人的一次创意实验开始
Doors Studio创始人Binh Diep曾在中国从事游戏设计工作十年。回到越南后，他决定把此前积累的经验用于创办自己的工作室。
Doors Studio没有成熟产品可以参考，初始团队也只有4个人。《BagMaster Isekai》最早更像是一次创意实验，没人能确定它最终能走多远。游戏吸收了背包构筑玩法中的库存管理与物品合成，又加入肉鸽成长、回合制战斗以及轻松诙谐的异世界题材。
玩家需要整理背包，将装备合成为更高阶物品，击败一波又一波敌人，并通过升级选项逐渐形成自己的流派。背包里的每一次摆放都会影响战斗表现，战斗产出的奖励又会带来新的构筑空间。这些系统彼此咬合，构成了产品最初的辨识度。
Binh回忆，项目刚开始时，他并不知道游戏能做到多大，也无法预测市场反应。团队只能先解决眼前的问题，把主要精力放在产品本身。
这种做法也贯穿了此后的研发过程。Doors Studio愿意尝试新方案，发现效果不理想时，也会果断放弃已经投入大量时间的设计。
随着产品逐渐成形，团队需要更准确地判断哪些调整真正有效。与SayGames合作后，Doors Studio开始借助数据和产品经验验证自己的选择。其中一项重要经验，是尽量减少对早期方案的依赖。只要证据表明存在更好的方向，团队就会重新搭建相关系统。
Binh表示，《BagMaster Isekai》与最早版本相比已经发生了巨大变化。研发期间，团队多次拆除并重做整套玩法系统。这些大改每次都让人承受很大压力，但回头来看，游戏也在每轮迭代后变得更加完整。
创意试验与产品验证结合后，最初的原型逐步具备了面向大众市场的潜力。不过，产品达到全球发行标准，只是下一阶段的起点。
全球玩家，比开发团队预想得更复杂
游戏上线后，Doors Studio很快面对一个更加复杂的用户环境。玩家来自不同地区，使用的设备横跨多个世代，游玩习惯也存在明显差异。设备碎片化带来了更多技术问题，团队处理的故障数量以及性能优化工作，都超过了此前预期。
玩家的内容消耗速度同样令人意外。
部分用户很快便掌握了游戏系统，推进速度远超团队设想。一些深度玩家会迅速消耗已有内容，将成长系统推向设计边界。这意味着团队必须更快补充内容，也要重新审视难度曲线和长期成长节奏。
全球玩家也给出了许多具有价值的建议。围绕玩法和数值平衡，社区提出了一些连开发团队都未曾想到的思路。
对Doors Studio来说，这段经历带来的一个直接启发是，研发团队很难仅凭自身经验想象全球市场的全部情况。产品上线后的真实反馈，往往会打破原有判断。所以Doors Studio在研发中会刻意为直觉留出空间。
团队先根据自身判断探索新想法和产品方向，随后通过数据、玩家反馈和市场分析进行验证。两个环节承担不同作用：直觉负责打开可能性，验证则帮助团队确认玩家是否真正接受这些设计。
SayGames为项目提供了分析基础设施。除了常规产品数据面板，Doors Studio还可以查看围绕《BagMaster Isekai》具体系统搭建的定制分析工具，并根据需要持续开展对照测试。
难度平衡就是一个典型案例。团队过去缺少面向全球用户的经验，而玩家对于难度的感受又高度主观。每当成长节奏需要调整时，Doors Studio都会利用对照测试比较不同方案，观察用户的实际反应后再作决定。
数据在这里并未取代创意。它让团队能更清楚地理解玩家，减少单纯依赖经验造成的误判。
产品扩大后，团队从4人增长到12人
产品进入全球市场后，开发商面对的已经不只是游戏研发。
若要在内部建立完整能力，团队需要投入大量时间和资金，还要持续招募相关人才。Doors Studio选择了另一种方式：工作室把主要精力放在游戏上，专业发行团队负责补齐外围能力。
据Binh介绍，SayGames在几个关键节点提供的支持，让研发成员能够继续专注产品。合作覆盖数据分析与产品管理，也包括质量测试、本地化、商店运营及用户获取等环节。
随着《BagMaster Isekai》成长，Doors Studio本身也在扩张。项目起步时只有4名开发者，全球上线时增加到7人。到了2026年6月，工作室已经拥有12名成员，规模达到最初的3倍。
Binh认为，团队成长是项目走上正轨的重要信号。《BagMaster Isekai》展现出的潜力，帮助工作室吸引到了更合适的人才，成员的专业能力也在研发过程中得到提升。
不过，团队扩张没有改变其产品思路。随着游戏进入持续运营阶段，活动和版本节奏会越来越重要，Doors Studio仍然把新内容与新玩法放在首位。对他们来说，玩家愿意长期留下的基础，依然是核心乐趣本身。
写在最后：给亚洲中小团队的一个参考样本
《BagMaster Isekai》的成长路径，提供了一个具有代表性的样本。
一支小团队先用鲜明创意做出原型，再通过频繁迭代提高完成度。产品获得初步验证后，团队借助发行商补足数据、投放和全球运营能力，逐步扩大用户与收入规模。
这条路径并不轻松。它要求开发者有足够明确的产品判断，也要接受数据检验，并在必要时推翻投入已久的设计。发行合作能够降低全球化门槛，真正决定产品上限的，仍是团队持续创造内容和理解玩家的能力。
从4个人的一次试验，产品上线仅两月，内购月收入就达到25万美元，《BagMaster Isekai》证明了亚洲小团队并不缺少进入全球市场的机会。找准自身最擅长的部分，再借助合适的合作伙伴补齐能力，有限的人力也可能支撑起一款快速增长的全球化产品。
目前，SayGames正在与包括亚洲团队在内的全球开发者合作，为产品提供数据分析、用户获取、商业化、本地化以及发行支持。

title: The AI bubble may not have burst yet, but $1 trillion worth of air appears to have escaped
text:
Many of tech's heaviest hitters have seen their share prices decrease significantly this week. For instance, Nvidia has seen a decrease of about 8% over the last five days—and this AI company is far from the only one seeing such a dip.
Over the last five days, we've seen share prices fall by 13% for AMD, and nearly 15% for Intel. Looking more broadly across the AI and semiconductor industries, CNBC reports 20 of the most valuable players have shed more than $1 trillion in value as investors sell off stock.
The bigger picture doesn't look any better: over the last five days, Samsung Electronics has seen its share price decrease by nearly 20%, SK hynix is down 18%, and Micron has seen a dip of over 15%.
A combination of factors have likely triggered this big chip stock sell off, including concerns that the memory supply crisis may actually reverse into oversupply come 2029, according to a recent column in South Korea's Maeil Business Newspaper .
There's more going on than just the CEO of Acer insisting " It's impossible for the shortage to last until 2030 !" We also know that many chip manufacturers have already been working to boost their production capacity, though TSMC's next-gen Arizona fab is fully booked before it has even been built .
(Image credit: TSMC) Chinese manufacturer CXMT is also growing, which is likely to go at least some way towards putting a dampener on the western market's aspirations. It's been stocking up on western DUV machines and is estimated to match Micron in terms of DRAM manufacturing capabilities this year . The chip manufacturer also recently claimed it had created breakthrough chip architecture that increases memory density . Make no mistake, CXMT is one to watch.
On top of that, The CEOs of both Intel and Broadcom recently claimed that financing could become a bigger hurdle to overcome for the AI industry than even securing memory or electricity supply. The uptick in interest rates means that investors may feel the balance between borrowing and the return on investment for big tech's data centre build out is looking increasingly lopsided.
So, is the AI bubble finally popping? Even as air is clearly escaping, it's still hard to say. The resulting lower share prices from this widespread stock sell-off may inspire some investors to buy, for one thing.
Despite the high price of these infrastructure projects, the demand for AI computing remains robust according to tech analyst Dan Ives for merchant bank Yorkville Ives. Ives told CNBC, "What would change our view is a demand signal, not [an increased interest] rate signal."
As such, big tech likely won't be ditching data centres any time soon, and the AI bubble may once again reach for something more party-balloon shaped in the future.

title: Come on Razer what are you doing? This Pokemon-themed mouse is most definitely not the one
text:
Upcoming Pokemon x Razer Viper V4 Pro https://t.co/qsAKwBhcg8 October 15, 2026
For a company that has made the best mouse I've ever laid my hands on, it sure seems to be doing its darndest to destroy that mystique. That is, assuming the latest images from Razer on Chinese site Billibilli of a Pokemon-themed Viper V4 Pro come to fruition (via Jakeu ). You can see it in the Tweet above, in all its glory—what do you think?
I think it looks bloody awful. There's just something about that peculiar mix of grey, yellow, and green that seems very uncoordinated. That, and the fact that the pixel art and yellow Poke-circle on the body of the mouse seem about as seamless as your average in-game graffiti emote. Just slapped on there without a care in the world.
I'm being harsh, but to be fair, this is right off the back of hearing about another potential version of the Viper V4 Pro that might cost $300 . At least, if the currency conversion is relevant and it is indeed listed for sale in the Chinese market, as is claimed.
Why can't a good thing be left alone? The Viper V4 Pro is fantastic, and that's in part because it looks sleek and simple, and because it's cheaper than other top-end gaming mice from big brands.
There's a chair, too, and a keyboard, which my colleague James says he prefers the look of to the mouse. I think I agree, but I still think the the grey clashes too much with the green.
Back to the Viper, though, there could have been a chance here to make a proper red-and-white, pokeball-themed version, but instead we get this grey-and-whatever-else monstrosity.
I'll just keep hold of the white one, thank you very much.

title: GTA 5 finally measures up to the actual best GTA game now I've added a jetpack
text:
Los Santos Customs
I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .
World War 2 Canadian air force pilot John Gillespie Magee Jr once wrote, in his poem High Flight:
Oh! I have slipped the surly bonds of Earth
And danced the skies on laughter-silvered wings;
Sunward I've climbed, and joined the tumbling mirth
of sun-split clouds,—and done a hundred things
He was talking about Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas, his favourite game and an icon of the PS2 generation of consoles. In San Andreas, tucked away in the Verdant Meadows Airstrip, the player could locate a jetpack, and tumble through the skies of Las Venturas like a glorious errant star. GTA 5? No jetpack. This is why it's an inferior game.
Until now. I have installed Aerowing - Wearable Jet Pack & Weapon System . Or, well, I installed it, tried to launch the game, crashed my PC, rebooted, tried to launch the game, crashed the game, rebooted, then launched the game.
It's a strangely lavish mod, I'll give it that. You don't just tap F and sort of limply ascend, which is mostly how it went in San Andreas. No, you get a whole animation, the camera circles your guy as he does a possibly-copyrighted Iron Man pose and launches himself skywards.
Then off you go, a speedometer in the corner measuring your courage as you glide along, launching one of three weapons: SMG, plasma, and "tube," which I'm pretty sure is just SMG again.
It's a rollocking good time, and it'll be even better once I find a way to proc it that doesn't also proc my street golfing mod. Until then, with silent lifting mind I'll tread the high untrespassed sanctity of space, put out my hand, and touch the face of God.
Sometimes you hit multiple buttons and things get really confused. (Image credit: Rockstar)

title: Control Resonant sells 1 million copies in 3 weeks to become Remedy's fastest-selling game ever
text:
Remedy announced today that Control Resonant has surpassed one million copies sold, moving past Alan Wake 2 to become "the fastest-selling game in Remedy Entertainment's 31-year history."
Thank you for the support ❤️ For playing, sharing, and being a part of the community.#CONTROLResonant
— @remedygames.com ( @remedygames.com.bsky.social ) 2026-10-15T18:14:33.049Z Three weeks to a million copies isn't exactly a blistering pace by conventional videogame standards: The Blood of Dawnwalker hit the mark in three days, Wardogs did it in one, and Subnautica 2 put out twice that number in just 12 hours.
But despite producing a string of unique, memorable, and critically acclaimed games, Remedy has never really smashed a massive home run in the sales department. Even Alan Wake 2, which won numerous awards for narrative and art direction in 2023 (and would have claimed so many more if not for the Baldur's Gate 3 behemoth) took two months to sell a million copies , significantly outpacing the original Control and making it the studio's fastest-selling game at that time.
Remedy's more pressing problem, though, is profit: It took more than a year, and two million copies sold, before Alan Wake 2 actually started making money for Remedy. Addressing that shortcoming was the top priority for Jean-Charles Gaudechon, who took over as the company's new CEO in February: Remedy chairman Henri Österlund said at the time that Gaudechon's appointment was intended "to lead Remedy into a phase of profitable growth."
So far, Gaudechon seems to like what he sees from Control Resonant, calling the million-sold mark "a very strong start."
"Control Resonant is Remedy's first self-published release of this scale, launched into one of the most competitive windows in years alongside the industry's biggest names. The game is unmistakably Remedy, with the bold ideas and distinctive style our players have come to expect from us," Gaudechon said. "A huge thank you goes to our players and to the team, who have made Control Resonant the incredible game that it is.
"We have always believed Control deserved an even bigger audience, and this launch shows what's possible: we see the game connecting with long-time fans while bringing a significant number of new players into the world of Control, which strengthens its long-term potential. With Control and Alan Wake, we now have two established franchises. Our focus is to build on what makes them special, support them, and grow them even further. There is a lot more to come from these worlds."
We'll get a closer look on how Control Resonant's success has impacted Remedy's bottom line in Remedy's Q3 business review, which takes place on November 3.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever devs say gear upgrades will stay relevant 'for a long, long time': 'It's very much our intention to try wherever we can to not invalidate old content'
text:
The developers of World of Warcraft: Forever, the venerable MMO's newest 'Classic+' flavor, say that even though the level cap is staying at 60, there will always be new gear to chase, and lower level gear has never been more powerful.
Blizzard Entertainment developers are wary of the drastic increases in power in WoW's modern version, including the recent Midnight expansion, which render previous seasons of gear irrelevant, require massive resets between expansions and lead to periodic stat "squishes" to avoid players becoming omnipotent gods.
"Classic wasn't far off from this," vice president and senior game director Ion Hazzikostas said of Forever's approach in a recent PC Gamer interview. "It's gradual. Going from [Classic raids] Blackwing Lair to Ahn'Qiraj that's actually only a couple of item levels higher. Those two largely coexist. C'thun drops are probably better than anything in Blackwing Lair, but that's like one or two items per player. This is a system that can last for a long, long time."
Associate production director Clay Stone says that's part of what makes gear in Forever—and Classic—meaningful.
"Your best-in-slot that you pick up from a previous raid tier may continue to be your best in slot for a long time. It's very much our intention to try wherever we can to not invalidate old content."
(Image credit: Blizzard Entertainment) Then again, a long time isn't expected to be literally forever, Hazzikostas says.
"At some point, if you're running the Barrow Deeps raid that's coming out in December, you're going to have all the items that you want. That's fine. You're done with it."
Forever players will see gear progress at level 60: those modest item level increases, gear that's good in specific niche situations, and rare "chase" pieces should keep people hunting, Forever developers say.
An item might be especially powerful when fighting in a desert, or against a dragon, for example, making it particularly good in one especially tough fight.
(And yes, players, developers are aware that this means bag space will be at a premium. "We're already thinking about that," principal designer Kris Zierhut says, mentioning the ideas of more bank space, trinket bags or even garment bags to hold the excess.)
Un-solving the game
(Image credit: Blizzard) Forever launches on November 4, and so far players have seen few of the pieces that will entice them at the end game. The current level cap in the beta is 30, and future items have been hidden from view and datamining to keep them guessing.
"We resurrected some old tech that keeps item stats and properties and tooltips secret, unknown to the client, until the item has actually been obtained by someone on the server," Hazzikostas says. "That's something we can use in modern WoW if we want."
Essentially a flag on items determines whether they are known, making them visible in the game's data. It trips when someone discovers an item for the first time, making sure that if the player links the item to others, it doesn't cause bugs
But until that moment, players can't get a sneak peek at what the piece of gear does. It's one reason why Forever doesn't have an Adventure Guide for dungeons; developers want the game to keep its secrets.
"Every single boss in our raids has some items that are very low percentage drop chase items, kind of like the Dragonspine Trophy was in Gruul's Lair—but for every boss," says Zierhut. "It might be three weeks, four weeks before somebody sees that item drop, and the whole meta is torn up again."
The goal is to keep the magic of exploration alive, he says.
"The goal is to un-solve the game, so players have to figure out again what's the best path," Zierhut says. "They don't know what the best items are. They don't know what to get. It's back to 2004 and nobody knows anything and figuring it out all over again."
Hand-crafted power
(Image credit: Blizzard) To add a layer of complexity—and, again, keep players from gaining power too quickly—items deliberately aren't optimized for players' preferred classes and stats. "Our items are much more idiosyncratic, and you don't get exactly what you want," he says, noting that knowing your class and choosing between gear sets will be one way players express skill in Forever. "None of the gear is perfect."
That's an old strategy—there are oft-discussed items from WoW's original launch that put strength on cloth gear, for example—but what is new is how much power items can have at a relatively low level.
Both low-level drops and crafted gear are powerful early, and that's on purpose, developers say.
"A lot of times tradeskills felt like an afterthought in Classic. Like, 'Oh, I could craft this item, but it's too much work and I'm about to out-level it anyway. Skip it. I'll level up my tailor when I get to level 60,' " Zierhut says. "I made a deliberate effort to make more crafting recipes worthwhile to craft while you are leveling up, including lowering the skill requirement to craft them.
"The typical item from tailoring, leatherworking, blacksmithing requires 25 fewer skill points than it used to. So you'll be able to craft that item right around the time it's your best-in-slot at that level and get the real value out of doing it."
Much of the tuning done so far to gear in Forever's beta has been to keep that idea of modest but steady progression across the whole leveling process.
"It's just a slightly different gradient in terms of power level," lead game designer Tim Jones says.

title: Street Fighter review roundup: sorry, folks, but it sounds like a mess
text:
I had such high hopes for the Street Fighter movie: The trailers were so promising, the cast so charismatic, and it seemed to get the inherent ridiculousness of the franchise, playing it seriously without ever really taking it too seriously. I mean, you don't put a guy like David Dastmalchian in the role of M. Bison unless you expect him to do something with it, right?
Alas, it seems that this may be a real Tuesday , at least for my Street Fighter movie aspirations. The reviews are in, and they are not especially kind. Street Fighter isn't a complete catastrophe, according to the critical consensus, but I don't think JCVD has to worry about having to turn in his "Best Street Fighter Movie" trophy anytime soon, either.
Here's what they're saying:
"Dumber than a box of rocks, but have you ever thrown rocks at things? It can be pretty fun"
IGN : 6/10
The story is too thin to support its bloated roster, but IGN reckons the Street Fighter film is "all about landing as many punches as it can before the round timer hits zero. Even though there are plenty of misses, the ones it does manage to land hit hard."
"A garish and incoherent mess that amuses in fits and starts but barely improves on the Mortal Kombat movies before it"
The Guardian : 2/5
Fans might enjoy the new SF flick, and the performances are "likeable," but its repeated self-knowing acknowledgment of how silly it all is "would land better if the movie ever rose above the stuff it’s making fun of. Instead, Street Fighter is satisfied punching down on itself, and everything that’s cringe about the '90s, while happily being stuck there, in the past, so it could pretend that this is as good as it gets for videogame adaptations."
"Not a great adaptation of what is one of the most recognizable brands in all of gaming"
Collider : 6/10
"The movie is at its most fun when it truly locks in for those high-octane fights and the surprisingly beautiful and not-much-publicized animated sequences," Collider reviewer Aidan Kelley wrote. "Unfortunately, to get to those, you have to deal with a lot of exposition and unengaging character drama."
"One of the most overtly mixed bags of any movie this year"
ScreenRant : 7/10
Despite calling Street Fighter "a fundamentally flawed movie on an underlying storytelling level," ScreenRant's review is one of the more positive takes floating around out there: The film is "buoyed by the overall 'go for broke' tone" and director Kitao Sakurai's "great work helming the film, working with the cast and crew to deliver consistently entertaining fight scenes that are flush with personality and style."
(Image credit: Paramount Pictures) "Like a trip to a ’90s mall arcade, Street Fighter’s pretty fun — for about 30 minutes"
ScreenCrush : 5/10
"The sheer absurdity and fevered intensity of the pacing, not to mention some very athletic fight choreography, is good enough to carry things along through the jittery first act," reviewer Matt Singer wrote for ScreenCrush. "But you can only mainline caffeine for so long before it starts to give you a headache."
"A campy '90s nostalgia ride and a complete mess"
Associated Press : 1/4
Street Fighter is a "very enthusiastic, weirdly convoluted and jumbled mess of a movie," Jake Coyle wrote for AP. As much as you might think a Street Fighter movie, good or bad, would at least offer up some bluntly entertaining hand-to-hand combat, it’s so messily plotted and chaotically conceived that it makes a game with six buttons seem comparatively artful."
"Dull fight scenes and tonal whiplash make this mostly forgettable videogame adaptation work only for superfans"
The Film Verdict
Street Fighter "is a little bit of everything that amounts to a lot of not-much," The Film Verdict declared, comparing it unfavorably to this year's Mortal Kombat and Resident Evil flicks: Street Fighter has all the elements that made those films successful, "but never lands on a formula than functions."
(Image credit: Paramount Pictures) "I’m not sure Street Fighter meets any conventional standard of quality, but it’s undeniably its own thing"
The Wrap
This review takes a more holistic approach to Street Fighter, calling it "an action-packed, hyper-stylized, borderline-nonsensical fever dream with a central storyline that begs to be taken seriously" despite being goofy, horny, largely incoherent, and somehow "even weirder" than the 1990s movie. But hey, maybe that's your thing: As reviewer William Bibbiani wrote, "What even is a 'good movie' anyway?"
"A jumbled tonal mess that feels deadly serious one moment and like parody the next"
The Hollywood Reporter
"Featuring so many characters and elements from the games that non-aficionados are left desperately attempting to keep up, Street Fighter tries to thread the needle between fan service and welcoming the uninitiated," THR says. "The result is that neither camp is likely to be fully satisfied."
(Image credit: Paramount Pictures) "Not even close to coherent, but it does have some good fight scenes"
Gizmodo
Gizmodo's review says the Street Fighter film is a bit like its portrayal of Ken Masters, an oafish clown who can actually fight: "The editing choices, scene transitions, and even the basic plot are frequently baffling. And yet, it can throw a punch when it wants to."
"The closest any filmmaker has come to bringing the franchise’s signature verve and bombast to the big screen"
Inverse
In another relatively positive review, Inverse declares that "Street Fighter might not be a film that sticks in your brain for days afterwards, but while you’re in your seat it feels like a shot of adrenaline to the arm, the kind that you might get from hearing the coveted 'You Win' announcement after the end of a hard-fought match."
(Image credit: Paramount Pictures) "Something goes terribly awry in its back half, hinting at either a troubled production, or one that was doomed from the start"
Variety
Variety was impressed by Street Fighter's strong start, but says the wheels come off in the second half: "It’s a film at war with itself, in which a straightforward narrative about strained brotherhood is spread far too thin across unconnected snippets of action and comedy that grow increasingly disparate."
So there you have it: Not a disaster, but definitely a mess. We'll hopefully have our own critical take on the Street Fighter film up eventually, if we can ever talk Mollie Taylor into going to see it; in the meantime, if you've seen it, let us know what you think.

title: Less than 2 weeks after announcing RuneScape Reignited, Jagex is scrapping the whole thing
text:
Life comes at you fast, as the saying goes, and the folks at RuneScape developer Jagex can sure attest to that. Less than two weeks after announcing RuneScape Reignited —essentially a way for new and lapsed players to restart their adventures from fresh on separate, unique servers—the studio has decided to cancel it.
There was trouble with RuneScape Reignited almost right from the start, with complaints ranging from a potential community split to restrictions on character interactions and the need to pay for a separate subscription. Just a few days after the initial announcement, Jagex apologized for making veteran players feel like they were being shunted aside, and said it was "exploring a heavy set of revisions to Reignited based on your feedback."
A few days after that, it laid out a more specific list of intended alterations , and invited more feedback from players, "so we can follow up next week with more of our thoughts." With that feedback now received, it seems that Jagex has heard enough.
"It is clear that we missed the mark on this, and so we are not moving forward with it," Mod Ryan—associate creative director Ryan Philpott—said in a blog post announcing the cancellation. "Our goal is to see Runescape grow again, with returning players coming back and new players joining, but never at the expense of our existing community."
It's a very sudden about-face, but not unprecedented. In 2023, for instance, Jagex dropped a new RuneScape battle pass in the wake of massive player backlash; in 2025, the studio scrapped "Treasure Hunter" microtransactions , in what Jagex CEO Jon Bellamy said was "part of a wider transformation across Jagex, which is seeing a renewed commitment to delivering deeper value, greater fairness and long-term improvements for players."
It hasn't been entirely smooth sailing: Recent price hikes have not gone over well (no surprise there, though), and Jagex's cowardly decision to scrap in-game Pride Month events was allowed to stand despite players absolutely mauling the studio for it. But in terms of gameplay, at least, Jagex has demonstrated a willingness to react with relative haste when it's blown things sufficiently badly—and this definitely qualifies.
Despite the cancellation, Philpott invited new and returning players to jump into the game with a 10 day free trial beginning on December 2, which will offer full access to all worlds and content. The 2027 roadmap for RuneScape also remains in place:
(Image credit: Jagex) "The future of RuneScape is still extremely bright," Philpott concluded. "RuneScape will always be built for and defined by its community. So please keep letting us know when you feel we're getting it wrong and shout with that same energy when you think we're getting it right too."

title: Steam achievements are getting a huge overhaul, with separate sets for DLC and season passes, and an easy way to compare with friends
text:
Valve has pushed a new update to its Steam client beta introducing big changes to how achievements work and how they're displayed. Developers can now create sets of achievements customized to their game, like mastering a specific character class or finishing a singleplayer campaign. Sets also distinguish base game achievements from separate DLC and seasonal sets.
Previously if you unlocked all achievements for a game you'd see a nice 'n' tidy 100% in your achievements list. But if that game got DLC with new achievements, that 100% would drop accordingly. I can understand why achievement heads would be annoyed by this: what if you have no intention of playing the DLC, but want to retain 100% completion bragging rights? This update fixes that, assuming devs use it.
It's a similar situation for seasonal achievements, which I can see working well with battle passes. The example Valve uses is a set called "Halloween Event Achievements" which are valid for a certain period and don't affect the achievement count of the base game. In other words: if you have the completionist itch but skip a season, it won't affect your base game stats.
All these changes have prompted a refresh of the achievements page. Most achievements info is now displayed on a single page: your progress towards overall completion, and your progress towards unlocking individual achievements.
(Image credit: Valve) I especially like that you can now directly compare achievements with up to three friends at once, which is what's being displayed at the bottom of the above image. This has been a feature on PlayStation consoles for a while, and so has separate sets for DLC achievements. It's nice that Valve has caught up.
Naturally, not every game on Steam will have implemented this new system yet, but the following games have:
